長官，收到！我看到您的截圖了，圖表區塊一片黑，且下方的 iframe 報表也沒有載入畫面。 根據我剛才吸收的系統架構與前端除錯經驗，這兩個問題的根本原因分別如下： ### 🚨 為什麼會一片空白？(兩大真兇) 1. 「其他都空白」(IFrame 未載入)：URL 編碼與 Emoji 問題 您在 HTML 中直接寫 `<iframe src="excelsql2.html?auto=🏭 量化策略工廠...">`。當網址列直接包含 Emoji (表情符號) 與中文空格 時，部分瀏覽器或 IIS 伺服器會無法正確解析這個 URL，導致 `excelsql2.html` 根本沒有被呼叫，所以一片空白。 👉 解法： 必須使用 JavaScript 的 `encodeURIComponent()` 進行安全的網址轉換。 2. 「圖形出不來」(ECharts 一片黑)：AJAX 資料為空或後端報錯 如果 `StockAI.aspx/ExecuteSQL` 執行失敗（例如資料表 `Strategy_Backtest_DailyNAV` 還沒建立、沒有資料，或是 C# 回傳的不是陣列），ECharts 隱藏了 Loading 動畫後，因為沒有數據，就會呈現一片死寂的深色背景。 👉 解法： 加上完善的錯誤捕捉，並且在沒有資料時自動塞入「模擬測試數據」，讓您先看到圖表長出來，證明前端沒問題！ --- ### 🛠️ 終極修復程式碼 請將您原本 `</body>` 前面的 `<script> ... </script>` 區塊，完全替換成以下這段強化的程式碼。我已經幫您寫好了動態 URL 編碼與圖表防呆機制：
html
<script>
    // 讓所有的 iframe 預設佔滿畫面
    $('iframe').css('height', '75vh').css('width', '100%').css('border', 'none');

    // 🚀 1. 動態安全載入 iframe (解決 URL 包含 Emoji 與中文導致瀏覽器解析失敗的空白問題)
    function loadIframesSafely() {
        const templates = {
            'iframe-factory': '🏭 量化策略工廠 ✕ 7大核心戰術生命週期與 Alpha 衰退監控塔',
            'iframe-sentinel': '🚨 離場守門人 ✕ 全市場專屬最佳均線 (5/10/20MA) 破線警戒榜',
            'iframe-amt': '👑 三核極致主升雷達 (幾何突破回測 ✕ 20日VAH突圍 ✕ 外資空間)',
            'iframe-etf': '💰 每月被動收入 1 萬元 (年領12萬) ✕ 需買張數與花費現金精算榜'
        };

        for (let id in templates) {
            // 使用 encodeURIComponent 確保中文與 Emoji 能安全透過網址傳遞給 excelsql2.html
            $('#' + id).attr('src', 'excelsql2.html?auto=' + encodeURIComponent(templates[id]));
        }
    }

    // 🚀 2. ECharts 繪製回測淨值曲線的核心邏輯 (加入強力除錯與防呆)
    function loadEquityCurve() {
        var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
        // 確保 DOM 存在且有長寬
        if (!chartDom) return;
        var myChart = echarts.init(chartDom);
        
        myChart.showLoading({ text: '📡 正在從資料庫撈取淨值數據...', color: '#38bdf8', textColor: '#fff', maskColor: 'rgba(8,15,26,0.8)' });

        var sql = `SELECT 日期, 總資產淨值, 累積報酬率_百分比 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Strategy_Backtest_DailyNAV ORDER BY 日期 ASC`;
        
        $.ajax({
            url: "StockAI.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
            type: "POST",
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            data: JSON.stringify({ sqlQuery: sql }),
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (res) {
                myChart.hideLoading();
                
                var data;
                try {
                    data = JSON.parse(res.d);
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error("JSON解析錯誤，後端回傳內容:", res.d);
                    alert("⚠️ 解析後端資料失敗，請按 F12 查看 Console");
                    return;
                }

                if (data.error) { 
                    alert("🚨 SQL 執行發生錯誤:\n" + data.error); 
                    return; 
                }

                // 🚨 防呆機制：如果資料庫是空的，自動塞入假資料讓圖表能顯示！
                if (data.length === 0) {
                    console.warn("資料表 Strategy_Backtest_DailyNAV 沒有資料，啟用模擬數據。");
                    // 模擬 10 天的資料
                    data = [
                        { "日期": "2023-01-01", "總資產淨值": 1000000, "累積報酬率_百分比": 0 },
                        { "日期": "2023-02-01", "總資產淨值": 1050000, "累積報酬率_百分比": 5 },
                        { "日期": "2023-03-01", "總資產淨值": 1030000, "累積報酬率_百分比": 3 },
                        { "日期": "2023-04-01", "總資產淨值": 1100000, "累積報酬率_百分比": 10 },
                        { "日期": "2023-05-01", "總資產淨值": 1250000, "累積報酬率_百分比": 25 }
                    ];
                    // 在圖表標題加上提示，讓長官知道這是測試資料
                    $('#equityChart').parent().prepend('<div class="alert alert-warning py-1 mb-1" style="font-size:12px;">⚠️ 警告：資料庫無資料，目前顯示為前端模擬數據。</div>');
                }

                var dates = [];
                var navs = [];
                
                data.forEach(function(row){
                    // 處理 C# 傳回來的日期可能帶有 T00:00:00 的問題
                    let cleanDate = row["日期"].toString().split('T')[0];
                    dates.push(cleanDate);
                    navs.push(row["總資產淨值"]);
                });

                var option = {
                    backgroundColor: '#111b2b',
                    tooltip: { 
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        formatter: function (params) {
                            // 自訂 Tooltip 加上逗號與金錢符號
                            let val = params[0].value.toLocaleString();
                            return params[0].name + '<br/>總資產淨值: <b>$' + val + '</b>';
                        }
                    },
                    grid: { left: '2%', right: '3%', bottom: '2%', containLabel: true },
                    xAxis: {
                        type: 'category',
                        boundaryGap: false,
                        data: dates,
                        axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#94a3b8' } }
                    },
                    yAxis: {
                        type: 'value',
                        scale: true, // 不強制從 0 開始，讓曲線起伏更明顯
                        axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#94a3b8' } },
                        splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#1e293b', type: 'dashed' } },
                        axisLabel: {
                            formatter: function (value) { return (value / 10000) + ' 萬'; } // Y軸顯示縮寫
                        }
                    },
                    dataZoom: [{ type: 'inside', start: 0, end: 100 }, { start: 0, end: 100, height: 15, bottom: 5 }],
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '總資產淨值',
                            type: 'line',
                            smooth: true,
                            symbol: 'circle',
                            symbolSize: 5,
                            showSymbol: false,
                            itemStyle: { color: '#38bdf8' },
                            lineStyle: { width: 3 },
                            areaStyle: {
                                color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 1, [
                                    { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.6)' },
                                    { offset: 0.8, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.05)' },
                                    { offset: 1, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.0)' }
                                ])
                            },
                            data: navs
                        }
                    ]
                };
                myChart.setOption(option);
            },
            error: function(err) {
                myChart.hideLoading();
                console.error("圖表 AJAX 請求失敗", err);
                alert("網路或後端發生錯誤！無法連線至 StockAI.aspx");
            }
        });
    }

    // 🚀 3. 畫面載入與視窗縮放處理
    $(document).ready(function(){
        // 先把 HTML 裡的 iframe src 清空，由 JS 安全載入
        $('iframe').attr('src', ''); 
        
        loadIframesSafely(); // 安全載入範本
        setTimeout(loadEquityCurve, 500); // 延遲半秒畫圖確保容器已渲染

        // 當視窗縮放時，圖表跟著 RWD 縮放
        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
            if(chartDom) {
                var myChart = echarts.getInstanceByDom(chartDom);
                if(myChart) myChart.resize();
            }
        });
        
        // 切換 Bootstrap 頁籤時，如果圖表在該頁籤內，重新計算寬高
        $('button[data-bs-toggle="tab"]').on('shown.bs.tab', function (e) {
            var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
            if(chartDom) {
                var myChart = echarts.getInstanceByDom(chartDom);
                if(myChart) myChart.resize();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    $('iframe').css('height', '75vh').css('width', '100%').css('border', 'none');

    // 🚀 1. 解決其他分頁沒資料的問題 (動態載入)
    function loadIframesSafely() {
        // ⚠️ 長官請注意：以下等號右邊的單引號內文字，必須跟您 excelsql2.html 下拉選單裡的文字「一字不差」！
        // 如果還是沒資料，請打開 excelsql2.html 確認選單名稱，並在這裡修改一致。
        const templates = {
            'iframe-factory': '🏭 量化策略工廠 ✕ 7大核心戰術生命週期與 Alpha 衰退監控塔',
            'iframe-sentinel': '🚨 離場守門人 ✕ 全市場專屬最佳均線 (5/10/20MA) 破線警戒榜',
            'iframe-amt': '👑 三核極致主升雷達 (幾何突破回測 ✕ 20日VAH突圍 ✕ 外資空間)',
            'iframe-etf': '💰 每月被動收入 1 萬元 (年領12萬) ✕ 需買張數與花費現金精算榜'
        };

        for (let id in templates) {
            $('#' + id).attr('src', 'excelsql2.html?auto=' + encodeURIComponent(templates[id]));
        }
    }

    // 🚀 2. 解決 ECharts 黑畫面：處理日期格式與數字轉型
    function loadEquityCurve() {
        var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
        if (!chartDom) return;
        var myChart = echarts.init(chartDom);
        
        myChart.showLoading({ text: '📡 正在繪製第 1 號策略淨值曲線...', color: '#38bdf8', textColor: '#fff', maskColor: 'rgba(8,15,26,0.8)' });

        // 💡 修正 1：加上 WHERE 回測編號 = 1，確保只畫同一條策略的線
        var sql = `SELECT 日期, 總資產淨值, 累積報酬率_百分比 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Strategy_Backtest_DailyNAV WHERE 回測編號 = 1 ORDER BY 日期 ASC`;
        
        $.ajax({
            url: "StockAI.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
            type: "POST",
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            data: JSON.stringify({ sqlQuery: sql }),
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (res) {
                myChart.hideLoading();
                var data = JSON.parse(res.d);

                if (data.error) { alert("🚨 SQL 錯誤:\n" + data.error); return; }
                if (data.length === 0) {
                    alert("查無 回測編號=1 的資料！");
                    return;
                }

                var dates = [];
                var navs = [];
                
                data.forEach(function(row){
                    // 💡 修正 2：處理日期格式 (將 "20260827" 轉換成 "2026-08-27")
                    let rawDate = row["日期"].toString().trim();
                    let cleanDate = rawDate;
                    if(rawDate.length === 8 && !rawDate.includes('-')) {
                        cleanDate = rawDate.substring(0,4) + '-' + rawDate.substring(4,6) + '-' + rawDate.substring(6,8);
                    } else if (rawDate.includes('T')) {
                        cleanDate = rawDate.split('T')[0];
                    }
                    dates.push(cleanDate);

                    // 💡 修正 3：確保淨值是數字 (Float)，否則 ECharts 畫不出線
                    navs.push(parseFloat(row["總資產淨值"]));
                });

                var option = {
                    backgroundColor: '#111b2b',
                    tooltip: { 
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        formatter: function (params) {
                            let val = params[0].value.toLocaleString();
                            return params[0].name + '<br/>總資產淨值: <b>$' + val + '</b>';
                        }
                    },
                    grid: { left: '2%', right: '3%', bottom: '2%', containLabel: true },
                    xAxis: {
                        type: 'category',
                        boundaryGap: false,
                        data: dates,
                        axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#94a3b8' } }
                    },
                    yAxis: {
                        type: 'value',
                        scale: true, // 自動計算 Y 軸起伏區間
                        axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#94a3b8' } },
                        splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#1e293b', type: 'dashed' } },
                        axisLabel: {
                            formatter: function (value) { return (value / 10000) + ' 萬'; }
                        }
                    },
                    dataZoom: [{ type: 'inside', start: 0, end: 100 }, { start: 0, end: 100, height: 15, bottom: 5 }],
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '總資產淨值',
                            type: 'line',
                            smooth: true,
                            symbol: 'circle',
                            symbolSize: 6,
                            showSymbol: true, // 顯示圓點，讓您清楚看到資料點
                            itemStyle: { color: '#38bdf8' },
                            lineStyle: { width: 3 },
                            areaStyle: {
                                color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 1, [
                                    { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.6)' },
                                    { offset: 1, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.0)' }
                                ])
                            },
                            data: navs
                        }
                    ]
                };
                myChart.setOption(option);
            },
            error: function(err) {
                myChart.hideLoading();
                alert("網路連線錯誤");
            }
        });
    }

    $(document).ready(function(){
        $('iframe').attr('src', ''); 
        loadIframesSafely(); 
        setTimeout(loadEquityCurve, 500); 

        window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
            var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
            if(chartDom) {
                var myChart = echarts.getInstanceByDom(chartDom);
                if(myChart) myChart.resize();
            }
        });
        
        $('button[data-bs-toggle="tab"]').on('shown.bs.tab', function (e) {
            var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
            if(chartDom) {
                var myChart = echarts.getInstanceByDom(chartDom);
                if(myChart) myChart.resize();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

    function loadEquityCurve() {
        var chartDom = document.getElementById('equityChart');
        if (!chartDom) return;
        var myChart = echarts.init(chartDom);
        
        myChart.showLoading({ text: '📡 正在連線 DataService2 讀取淨值...', color: '#38bdf8', textColor: '#fff', maskColor: 'rgba(8,15,26,0.8)' });

        // SQL 指令：確保只抓取回測編號為 1 的資料
        var querySql = "SELECT 日期, 總資產淨值, 累積報酬率_百分比 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Strategy_Backtest_DailyNAV WHERE 回測編號 = 1 ORDER BY 日期 ASC";
        
        $.ajax({
            // ✅ 修正 1：換上正確的跨網域 API 絕對路徑
            url: "https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/DataService2.aspx/ExecuteSQL",
            type: "POST",
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            // ✅ 修正 2 & 3：使用正確的參數名稱 sql，並補上 db 與 pwd (***)
            data: JSON.stringify({ 
                sql: querySql, 
                db: "stockchangedate", 
                pwd: "***" 
            }),
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (res) {
                myChart.hideLoading();
                var dataStr = res.d;

                // 錯誤處理
                if (dataStr.startsWith("錯誤：")) {
                    alert("🚨 SQL 執行發生錯誤:\n" + dataStr);
                    return;
                }

                var data;
                try {
                    data = JSON.parse(dataStr);
                } catch (e) {
                    alert("⚠️ 系統回傳無法解析的格式，請按 F12 查看 Console");
                    console.error("JSON解析錯誤:", dataStr);
                    return;
                }

                if (data.length === 0) {
                    alert("查無 回測編號=1 的淨值資料！");
                    return;
                }

                var dates = [];
                var navs = [];
                
                data.forEach(function(row){
                    // 處理 8 碼日期 (如 "20260827" -> "2026-08-27")
                    let rawDate = row["日期"].toString().trim();
                    let cleanDate = rawDate;
                    if(rawDate.length === 8 && !rawDate.includes('-')) {
                        cleanDate = rawDate.substring(0,4) + '-' + rawDate.substring(4,6) + '-' + rawDate.substring(6,8);
                    } else if (rawDate.includes('T')) {
                        cleanDate = rawDate.split('T')[0];
                    }
                    dates.push(cleanDate);

                    // 確保總資產淨值是數字
                    navs.push(parseFloat(row["總資產淨值"]));
                });

                var option = {
                    backgroundColor: '#111b2b',
                    tooltip: { 
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        formatter: function (params) {
                            let val = params[0].value.toLocaleString();
                            return params[0].name + '<br/>總資產淨值: <b style="color:#38bdf8;">$' + val + '</b>';
                        }
                    },
                    grid: { left: '2%', right: '4%', top: '10%', bottom: '2%', containLabel: true },
                    xAxis: {
                        type: 'category',
                        boundaryGap: false,
                        data: dates,
                        axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#94a3b8' } }
                    },
                    yAxis: {
                        type: 'value',
                        scale: true, // 不從 0 開始，放大起伏
                        axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#94a3b8' } },
                        splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: '#1e293b', type: 'dashed' } },
                        axisLabel: {
                            formatter: function (value) { return (value / 10000) + ' 萬'; }
                        }
                    },
                    dataZoom: [
                        { type: 'inside', start: 0, end: 100 }, 
                        { start: 0, end: 100, height: 15, bottom: 5, textStyle: {color: '#94a3b8'} }
                    ],
                    series: [
                        {
                            name: '總資產淨值',
                            type: 'line',
                            smooth: true,
                            symbol: 'circle',
                            symbolSize: 6,
                            showSymbol: true,
                            itemStyle: { color: '#38bdf8' },
                            lineStyle: { width: 3, shadowBlur: 8, shadowColor: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.5)' }, // 加入光暈效果
                            areaStyle: {
                                color: new echarts.graphic.LinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 1, [
                                    { offset: 0, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.6)' },
                                    { offset: 1, color: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.0)' }
                                ])
                            },
                            data: navs
                        }
                    ]
                };
                myChart.setOption(option);
            },
            error: function(xhr) {
                myChart.hideLoading();
                alert("❌ 連線至 DataService2 發生伺服器錯誤！");
                console.error("AJAX 錯誤:", xhr.responseText);
            }
        });
    }

import flet as ft
import subprocess
import threading
import os
import sys

# 97 支部隊編制範本字典 (長官可自由擴充路徑與參數)
PYTHON_SCRIPTS = [
    {"name": "Telegram 雙向機器人", "file": "zen_ai_bot1.py", "cat": "社群廣播", "desc": "Gemini 4金鑰輪詢池中樞"},
    {"name": "Facebook 自動解盤", "file": "fb_comment_responder.py", "cat": "社群廣播", "desc": "Post ID 唯一防重複解盤"},
    {"name": "AMT 價值區突圍回測", "file": "amt_strategy_backtest.py", "cat": "策略工廠", "desc": "策略 2：70% VAH 突圍量化引擎"},
    {"name": "存股總報酬回測", "file": "dividend_strategy_backtest.py", "cat": "策略工廠", "desc": "策略 3：DRIP 股息再投入複利"},
    {"name": "玩股網三大法人同步", "file": "sync_stock_threemaster.py", "cat": "數據採集", "desc": "外資、投信、自營商期貨籌碼抓取"},
    {"name": "Playwright 自動截圖", "file": "chart_screenshot.py", "cat": "RPA視覺", "desc": "無頭瀏覽器產出四大圖表截圖"}
]

SCRIPT_DIR = r"C:\test_c" # 腳本實體目錄

def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "🌟 Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦 V1.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.bgcolor = "#080f1a" # 對齊戰情深藍
    page.padding = 20

    # 黑色即時終端機視窗
    console_output = ft.Text(value="[系統就緒] 等待長官指派戰鬥任務...\n", color="#38bdf8", font_family="Consolas", size=13)
    console_container = ft.Container(
        content=ft.Column([console_output], scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO),
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border=ft.border.all(1, "#1e293b"),
        border_radius=8,
        padding=15,
        height=320,
        expand=True
    )

    def log(msg):
        console_output.value += msg + "\n"
        page.update()

    def run_script(file_name):
        def worker():
            log(f"\n🚀 [發射指令] 正在喚醒: {file_name} ...")
            full_path = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, file_name)
            
            # 使用子進程隔離調度，即時抓取 stdout / stderr
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                [sys.executable, full_path],
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
                shell=False
            )
            for line in process.stdout:
                log(f"[{file_name}] {line.strip()}")
            process.wait()
            log(f"🏁 [{file_name}] 執行完畢，Exit Code: {process.returncode}\n")

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    # 生成腳本卡片清單
    cards = []
    for item in PYTHON_SCRIPTS:
        cards.append(
            ft.Card(
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([
                        ft.Row([
                            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.TERMINAL, color="#38bdf8"),
                            ft.Text(item["name"], weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#e2e8f0", size=16),
                        ]),
                        ft.Text(f"檔案: {item['file']}", size=12, color="#94a3b8"),
                        ft.Text(item["desc"], size=12, color="#64748b"),
                        ft.ElevatedButton(
                            "立即發射",
                            icon=ft.Icons.PLAY_ARROW,
                            bgcolor="#0284c7",
                            color="#ffffff",
                            on_click=lambda e, f=item["file"]: run_script(f)
                        )
                    ]),
                    padding=15,
                    bgcolor="#111b2b",
                    border_radius=8,
                    border=ft.border.all(1, "#1e293b")
                )
            )
        )

    # 頁面主佈局
    page.add(
        ft.Row([
            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.SATELLITE_ALT, color="#38bdf8", size=30),
            ft.Text("Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦", size=24, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
        ]),
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b"),
        ft.Text("⚔️ 戰鬥序列管理面板", size=18, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#e2e8f0"),
        ft.ResponsiveRow([ft.Container(c, col={"sm": 12, "md": 6, "lg": 4}) for c in cards]),
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b"),
        ft.Text("📡 即時輸出終端 (Live Telemetry)", size=16, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
        console_container
    )

# 🌐 支援純 Web 發佈：指定 Port 即可在瀏覽器開啟
if __name__ == "__main__":
    ft.app(target=main, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER, port=8550)

RUNNING_PROCESSES = {}

def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "🌟 Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦 V2.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.bgcolor = "#080f1a"
    page.padding = 18

    # 終端日誌物件
    console_output = ft.Text(value="[系統就緒] 等待長官指派戰鬥任務...\n", color="#38bdf8", font_family="Consolas", size=13)
    console_scroll_col = ft.Column([console_output], scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO)
    
    console_container = ft.Container(
        content=console_scroll_col,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b"),
        border_radius=8,
        padding=12,
        height=280,
        expand=True
    )

    def log(msg):
        console_output.value += msg + "\n"
        page.update()
        try:
            console_scroll_col.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def clear_console(e):
        console_output.value = "[終端已重置] 等待戰鬥任務...\n"
        page.update()

    def run_script(file_name, status_btn):
        if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
            log(f"🛑 [強制煞車] 正在終止: {file_name} (PID: {RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].pid}) ...")
            try:
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].terminate()
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"⚠️ 終止失敗: {e}")
            return

        def worker():
            full_path = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, file_name)
            log(f"\n🚀 [發射指令] 正在以無緩衝管道喚醒: {file_name} ...")
            
            status_btn.text = "🛑 強制終止"
            status_btn.bgcolor = "#ef4444"
            page.update()

            env = os.environ.copy()
            env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

            try:
                cmd = [sys.executable, "-u", full_path] if file_name.endswith(".py") else [full_path]
                process = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    text=True,
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="replace",
                    cwd=SCRIPT_DIR,
                    env=env,
                    shell=False
                )
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name] = process
                log(f"📡 [進程已鎖定] {file_name} 啟動成功，PID: {process.pid}")

                for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
                    if line:
                        log(f"[{file_name}] {line.strip()}")
                
                process.wait()
                log(f"🏁 [{file_name}] 進程結束，Exit Code: {process.returncode}\n")
            except Exception as ex:
                log(f"❌ 執行異常: {ex}\n")
            finally:
                if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
                    del RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name]
                status_btn.text = "立即發射"
                status_btn.bgcolor = "#0284c7"
                page.update()

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    cards_container = ft.ResponsiveRow([])

    current_filter = {"cat": "全部", "query": ""}

    def build_cards():
        cards_container.controls.clear()
        query = current_filter["query"].lower()
        selected_cat = current_filter["cat"]

        filtered_list = []
        for s in PYTHON_SCRIPTS:
            cat_match = (selected_cat == "全部") or (s["cat"] == selected_cat)
            query_match = (query in s["name"].lower()) or (query in s["file"].lower()) or (query in s["desc"].lower())
            if cat_match and query_match:
                filtered_list.append(s)

        for item in filtered_list:
            f = item["file"]
            is_daemon = item.get("daemon", False)
            
            is_running = f in RUNNING_PROCESSES
            btn = ft.Button(
                "🛑 強制終止" if is_running else "立即發射",
                icon=ft.Icons.STOP if is_running else ft.Icons.PLAY_ARROW,
                bgcolor="#ef4444" if is_running else "#0284c7",
                color="#ffffff"
            )
            btn.on_click = (lambda file_name=f, btn_ref=btn: lambda e: run_script(file_name, btn_ref))()

            badge_text = "常駐守護" if is_daemon else "批次任務"
            badge_color = "#f59e0b" if is_daemon else "#10b981"
            safe_padding = ft.Padding.symmetric(horizontal=6, vertical=2) if hasattr(ft, "Padding") else 4

            card = ft.Card(
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([
                        ft.Row([
                            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.TERMINAL, color="#38bdf8", size=18),
                            ft.Text(item["name"], weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#e2e8f0", size=15),
                            ft.Container(
                                content=ft.Text(badge_text, size=10, color="#ffffff"),
                                bgcolor=badge_color,
                                padding=safe_padding,
                                border_radius=4
                            )
                        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
                        ft.Text(f"檔案: {item['file']}", size=12, color="#94a3b8"),
                        ft.Text(item["desc"], size=11, color="#64748b", max_lines=2, overflow=ft.TextOverflow.ELLIPSIS),
                        btn
                    ]),
                    padding=12,
                    bgcolor="#111b2b",
                    border_radius=8,
                    border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b")
                )
            )
            cards_container.controls.append(ft.Container(card, col={"sm": 12, "md": 6, "lg": 4}))

        page.update()

    def on_search_change(e):
        current_filter["query"] = e.control.value
        build_cards()

    search_box = ft.TextField(
        hint_text="🔍 搜尋部隊名稱、檔案名稱 (如: 2330, backtest, bot, yahoo)...",
        prefix_icon=ft.Icons.SEARCH,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border_color="#1e293b",
        focused_border_color="#38bdf8",
        color="#e2e8f0",
        height=45,
        on_change=on_search_change,
        expand=True
    )

    # 🚀 【戰術分類藥丸切換列】：100% 避開 Flet 1.0 的 Tab 衝突，外觀更科技！
    categories = [
        ("🌟 全部 (24+)", "全部"),
        ("🤖 社群廣播", "社群廣播"),
        ("🏭 策略工廠", "策略工廠"),
        ("📡 數據採集", "數據採集"),
        ("📸 RPA視覺", "RPA視覺"),
        ("⚙️ 系統維護", "系統維護"),
    ]

    cat_bar = ft.Row(scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO, spacing=8)

    def select_category(cat_val):
        current_filter["cat"] = cat_val
        render_cat_bar()
        build_cards()

    def render_cat_bar():
        cat_bar.controls.clear()
        for label, val in categories:
            is_active = (current_filter["cat"] == val)
            btn = ft.Button(
                label,
                bgcolor="#0284c7" if is_active else "#111b2b",
                color="#ffffff" if is_active else "#94a3b8",
                on_click=lambda e, c=val: select_category(c)
            )
            cat_bar.controls.append(btn)
        page.update()

    page.add(
        ft.Row([
            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.SATELLITE_ALT, color="#38bdf8", size=28),
            ft.Text("Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
        ]),
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b"),
        ft.Row([search_box]),
        cat_bar, # 分類藥丸列
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b", height=10),
        cards_container,
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b"),
        ft.Row([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Icon(ft.Icons.MONITOR_HEART, color="#22c55e", size=18),
                ft.Text("📡 即時輸出終端 (Live Telemetry)", size=15, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
            ]),
            ft.Button("清空日誌", icon=ft.Icons.CLEAR_ALL, bgcolor="#334155", color="#ffffff", on_click=clear_console)
        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
        console_container
    )

    render_cat_bar()
    build_cards()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if hasattr(ft, "run"):
        try:
            ft.run(main, port=8550, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
        except TypeError:
            ft.run(main)
    else:

RUNNING_PROCESSES = {}
# 戰情報告歷史庫：[(text, is_critical, color)]
LOG_HISTORY = []

def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "🌟 Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦 V2.1 (戰術情報過濾版)"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.bgcolor = "#080f1a"
    page.padding = 18

    # 關鍵情報切換開關 (預設開啟：只看關鍵訊息)
    filter_switch = ft.Switch(label="🎯 僅顯示關鍵戰報", value=True)

    console_column = ft.Column(spacing=3, scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO)
    console_container = ft.Container(
        content=console_column,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b"),
        border_radius=8,
        padding=12,
        height=300,
        expand=True
    )

    # 判斷訊息是否為關鍵情報及其顯示顏色
    def evaluate_critical_info(raw_text):
        lower = raw_text.lower()
        
        # 1. 紫色：長官指令
        if "收到用戶指令" in raw_text or "用戶" in raw_text:
            return True, "#c084fc"
        
        # 2. 紅色：警報、報錯、衝突
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚨", "❌", "錯誤", "error", "exception", "traceback", "409", "conflict", "終止"]):
            return True, "#ef4444"

        # 3. 綠色：成功、截圖產出、回測完成、進程結束
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["✅", "🏁", "成功", "完成", "更新", "報酬率", "勝率", "年化"]):
            return True, "#22c55e"

        # 4. 藍色：進程喚醒、鎖定
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚀", "📡", "發射指令", "進程已鎖定"]):
            return True, "#38bdf8"

        # 5. 黃色：金叉、突破、戰術解盤
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🔥", "⭐", "突破", "金叉", "共振", "解盤", "伏兵"]):
            return True, "#facc15"

        # 其餘皆視為底層背景雜訊
        return False, "#64748b"

    def refresh_console_ui():
        console_column.controls.clear()
        only_critical = filter_switch.value
        
        # 抓取最近 200 筆紀錄
        for text, is_crit, color in LOG_HISTORY[-200:]:
            if only_critical and not is_crit:
                continue
            console_column.controls.append(
                ft.Text(text, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas")
            )
        page.update()
        try:
            console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def log(msg):
        is_crit, color = evaluate_critical_info(msg)
        LOG_HISTORY.append((msg, is_crit, color))
        
        # 若當前設定需要顯示，即時追加一行 (節省全重繪資源)
        if not filter_switch.value or is_crit:
            console_column.controls.append(
                ft.Text(msg, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas")
            )
            page.update()
            try:
                console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def on_filter_toggle(e):
        refresh_console_ui()

    filter_switch.on_change = on_filter_toggle

    def clear_console(e):
        LOG_HISTORY.clear()
        console_column.controls.clear()
        log("📡 [終端已重置] 等待戰情指令...")

    def run_script(file_name, status_btn):
        if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
            log(f"🛑 [強制煞車] 正在終止: {file_name} (PID: {RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].pid}) ...")
            try:
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].terminate()
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"⚠️ 終止失敗: {e}")
            return

        def worker():
            full_path = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, file_name)
            log(f"\n🚀 [發射指令] 正在以無緩衝管道喚醒: {file_name} ...")
            
            status_btn.text = "🛑 強制終止"
            status_btn.bgcolor = "#ef4444"
            page.update()

            env = os.environ.copy()
            env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

            try:
                cmd = [sys.executable, "-u", full_path] if file_name.endswith(".py") else [full_path]
                process = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    text=True,
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="replace",
                    cwd=SCRIPT_DIR,
                    env=env,
                    shell=False
                )
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name] = process
                log(f"📡 [進程已鎖定] {file_name} 啟動成功，PID: {process.pid}")

                for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
                    if line:
                        log(f"[{file_name}] {line.strip()}")
                
                process.wait()
                log(f"🏁 [{file_name}] 進程結束，Exit Code: {process.returncode}\n")
            except Exception as ex:
                log(f"❌ 執行異常: {ex}\n")
            finally:
                if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
                    del RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name]
                status_btn.text = "立即發射"
                status_btn.bgcolor = "#0284c7"
                page.update()

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    cards_container = ft.ResponsiveRow([])
    current_filter = {"cat": "全部", "query": ""}

    def build_cards():
        cards_container.controls.clear()
        query = current_filter["query"].lower()
        selected_cat = current_filter["cat"]

        filtered_list = []
        for s in PYTHON_SCRIPTS:
            cat_match = (selected_cat == "全部") or (s["cat"] == selected_cat)
            query_match = (query in s["name"].lower()) or (query in s["file"].lower()) or (query in s["desc"].lower())
            if cat_match and query_match:
                filtered_list.append(s)

        for item in filtered_list:
            f = item["file"]
            is_daemon = item.get("daemon", False)
            
            is_running = f in RUNNING_PROCESSES
            btn = ft.Button(
                "🛑 強制終止" if is_running else "立即發射",
                icon=ft.Icons.STOP if is_running else ft.Icons.PLAY_ARROW,
                bgcolor="#ef4444" if is_running else "#0284c7",

            card = ft.Card(
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([

                                bgcolor=badge_color,
                                padding=safe_padding,

                        ft.Text(f"檔案: {item['file']}", size=12, color="#94a3b8"),

                    ]),
                    padding=12,
                    bgcolor="#111b2b",
                    border_radius=8,
                    border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b")

    ]

        render_cat_bar()

    def render_cat_bar():
        cat_bar.controls.clear()

            )

        page.update()

    page.add(
        ft.Row([

        ft.Row([

                ft.Text("📡 即時輸出終端 (Live Telemetry)", size=15, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
            ]),
            ft.Row([

                ft.Button("清空日誌", icon=ft.Icons.CLEAR_ALL, bgcolor="#334155", color="#ffffff", on_click=clear_console)
            ])
        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
        console_container
    )

    render_cat_bar()
    build_cards()
    log("📡 [系統就緒] 戰術情報過濾中樞已啟動，預設只顯示關鍵戰報...")

if __name__ == "__main__":

報告長官！這個錯誤訊息是 Windows 網路通訊最經典的 Port 衝突錯誤： > `[Errno 10048] 一次只能用一個通訊端位址 (通訊協定/網路位址/連接埠)` ### 🔍 原因解析 這代表 Port `8550` 已經被剛剛執行的舊版母艦程式給佔用了！ 剛才按 `Ctrl + C` 時，底層的 Python / Uvicorn 服務還殘留在 Windows 背景中沒有完全退出，導致新版程式想要綁定 8550 埠時被系統阻擋。 --- ### 🛠️ 終極解法：一鍵釋放 8550 連接埠 長官不需要重開機，請直接在 命令提示字元 (CMD) 中執行以下任一方式即可秒級排除： #### 方案 A：一鍵強制釋放指令（最快，推薦 👍） 請直接將以下這行指令複製並貼到 CMD 按 Enter：
cmd
for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -aon ^| findstr :8550') do taskkill /f /pid %a
*(系統會自動抓出佔用 8550 的殘留程式，並將其強制終止！)* --- #### 方案 B：手動查詢並終止 (兩步完成) 如果指令沒有反應，可以手動輸入： 1. 查詢佔用 8550 的程式編號 (PID)：
cmd
   netstat -ano | findstr :8550
*(您會看到類似 `TCP 0.0.0.0:8550 ... LISTENING 12345`，最右邊的數字就是 PID)* 2. 強制結束該 PID（假設數字是 12345）：
cmd
   taskkill /F /PID 12345
--- ### 🚀 釋放後重新發射 連接埠清理完畢後，再次執行發射指令：

這一次將順利綁定 `http://127.0.0.1:8550`，戰術情報過濾中樞即刻就緒！長官請重新點火！

        padding=12,
        height=300,
        expand=True
    )

    def evaluate_critical_info(raw_text):
        if "收到用戶指令" in raw_text or "用戶" in raw_text:
            return True, "#c084fc"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚨", "❌", "錯誤", "error", "exception", "traceback", "409", "conflict", "終止", "攔截"]):
            return True, "#ef4444"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["✅", "🏁", "成功", "完成", "更新", "報酬率", "勝率", "年化", "授權通過"]):
            return True, "#22c55e"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚀", "📡", "發射指令", "進程已鎖定", "安全核准"]):
            return True, "#38bdf8"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🔥", "⭐", "突破", "金叉", "共振", "解盤", "伏兵"]):
            return True, "#facc15"
        return False, "#64748b"

    def refresh_console_ui():
        console_column.controls.clear()
        only_critical = filter_switch.value
        for text, is_crit, color in LOG_HISTORY[-200:]:
            if only_critical and not is_crit:
                continue
            console_column.controls.append(ft.Text(text, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas"))
        page.update()
        try:
            console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def log(msg):
        is_crit, color = evaluate_critical_info(msg)
        LOG_HISTORY.append((msg, is_crit, color))
        if not filter_switch.value or is_crit:
            console_column.controls.append(ft.Text(msg, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas"))
            page.update()
            try:
                console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def show_alert(msg, color="#ef4444"):
        try:
            snack = ft.SnackBar(ft.Text(msg, color="#ffffff"), bgcolor=color)
            if hasattr(page, "open"):
                page.open(snack)
            else:
                page.snack_bar = snack
                page.snack_bar.open = True
                page.update()
        except Exception:
            pass

        else:
            lock_status_icon.icon = ft.Icons.LOCK
            lock_status_icon.color = "#ef4444"
            lock_status_icon.tooltip = "作戰權限已鎖定 (唯讀觀測模式)"
        page.update()

    commander_key_input.on_change = on_key_change
    filter_switch.on_change = lambda e: refresh_console_ui()

    def clear_console(e):

        console_column.controls.clear()

    # 🚀 進程發射調度器 (注入最高安全密鑰檢驗)
    def run_script(file_name, status_btn):
        # 🚨【最高安全防禦線】：驗證指揮官授權碼
        if commander_key_input.value != MASTER_PASSWORD:
            log(f"🚨 [安全防禦攔截] 權限不足！操作【{file_name}】已被拒絕！請先於頂部輸入長官授權密碼！")
            show_alert("⚠️ 權限不足！此為實戰作戰指令，請先於頂部輸入長官授權密碼！", color="#ef4444")
            return

        if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
            log(f"🛑 [強制煞車] 正在終止: {file_name} (PID: {RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].pid}) ...")
            try:
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].terminate()
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"⚠️ 終止失敗: {e}")
            return

        def worker():
            full_path = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, file_name)
            log(f"\n🚀 [發射指令] 正在以無緩衝管道喚醒: {file_name} ...")
            
            status_btn.text = "🛑 強制終止"
            status_btn.bgcolor = "#ef4444"
            page.update()

            env = os.environ.copy()
            env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

            try:
                cmd = [sys.executable, "-u", full_path] if file_name.endswith(".py") else [full_path]
                process = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    text=True,
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="replace",
                    cwd=SCRIPT_DIR,
                    env=env,
                    shell=False
                )
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name] = process
                log(f"📡 [進程已鎖定] {file_name} 啟動成功，PID: {process.pid}")

                for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
                    if line:
                        log(f"[{file_name}] {line.strip()}")
                
                process.wait()
                log(f"🏁 [{file_name}] 進程結束，Exit Code: {process.returncode}\n")
            except Exception as ex:
                log(f"❌ 執行異常: {ex}\n")
            finally:
                if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
                    del RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name]
                status_btn.text = "立即發射"
                status_btn.bgcolor = "#0284c7"
                page.update()

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    cards_container = ft.ResponsiveRow([])
    current_filter = {"cat": "全部", "query": ""}

    def build_cards():
        cards_container.controls.clear()
        query = current_filter["query"].lower()
        selected_cat = current_filter["cat"]

        filtered_list = []
        for s in PYTHON_SCRIPTS:
            cat_match = (selected_cat == "全部") or (s["cat"] == selected_cat)
            query_match = (query in s["name"].lower()) or (query in s["file"].lower()) or (query in s["desc"].lower())
            if cat_match and query_match:
                filtered_list.append(s)

        for item in filtered_list:
            f = item["file"]
            is_daemon = item.get("daemon", False)
            
            is_running = f in RUNNING_PROCESSES
            btn = ft.Button(
                "🛑 強制終止" if is_running else "立即發射",
                icon=ft.Icons.STOP if is_running else ft.Icons.PLAY_ARROW,
                bgcolor="#ef4444" if is_running else "#0284c7",
                color="#ffffff"
            )
            btn.on_click = (lambda file_name=f, btn_ref=btn: lambda e: run_script(file_name, btn_ref))()

            badge_text = "常駐守護" if is_daemon else "批次任務"
            badge_color = "#f59e0b" if is_daemon else "#10b981"
            safe_padding = ft.Padding.symmetric(horizontal=6, vertical=2) if hasattr(ft, "Padding") else 4

            card = ft.Card(
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([
                        ft.Row([
                            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.TERMINAL, color="#38bdf8", size=18),
                            ft.Text(item["name"], weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#e2e8f0", size=15),
                            ft.Container(
                                content=ft.Text(badge_text, size=10, color="#ffffff"),
                                bgcolor=badge_color,
                                padding=safe_padding,
                                border_radius=4
                            )
                        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
                        ft.Text(f"檔案: {item['file']}", size=12, color="#94a3b8"),
                        ft.Text(item["desc"], size=11, color="#64748b", max_lines=2, overflow=ft.TextOverflow.ELLIPSIS),
                        btn
                    ]),
                    padding=12,
                    bgcolor="#111b2b",
                    border_radius=8,
                    border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b")
                )
            )
            cards_container.controls.append(ft.Container(card, col={"sm": 12, "md": 6, "lg": 4}))

        page.update()

    def on_search_change(e):
        current_filter["query"] = e.control.value
        build_cards()

    search_box = ft.TextField(
        hint_text="🔍 搜尋部隊名稱、檔案名稱 (如: 2330, backtest, bot, yahoo)...",
        prefix_icon=ft.Icons.SEARCH,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border_color="#1e293b",
        focused_border_color="#38bdf8",
        color="#e2e8f0",
        height=45,
        on_change=on_search_change,
        expand=True
    )

    categories = [
        ("🌟 全部 (24+)", "全部"),
        ("🤖 社群廣播", "社群廣播"),
        ("🏭 策略工廠", "策略工廠"),
        ("📡 數據採集", "數據採集"),
        ("📸 RPA視覺", "RPA視覺"),
        ("⚙️ 系統維護", "系統維護"),
    ]

    cat_bar = ft.Row(scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO, spacing=8)

    def select_category(cat_val):
        current_filter["cat"] = cat_val
        render_cat_bar()
        build_cards()

    def render_cat_bar():
        cat_bar.controls.clear()

            is_active = (current_filter["cat"] == val)

            )
            cat_bar.controls.append(btn)
        page.update()

    # 頁面總體佈局
    page.add(

            ]),

    {"name": "戰情二室圖形更新批次檔", "file": "戰情二室圖形更新.bat", "cat": "策略工廠", "desc": "一鍵依序執行策略 2 與策略 3 回測展期", "daemon": False, "sandbox": False},

    {"name": "全市場分價量表同步 (Yahoo)", "file": "sync_daily_price_volume.py", "cat": "數據採集", "desc": "產出 70% 價值區 VAH/VAL/POC 微結構", "daemon": False, "sandbox": False},
    {"name": "盤後大一統籌碼採集", "file": "autorunyahoo1.py", "cat": "數據採集", "desc": "盤後第一道防線：分點進出與個股行情", "daemon": False, "sandbox": False},
    {"name": "盤中離場守門人守護進程", "file": "exit_sentinel_daemon.py", "cat": "系統維護", "desc": "盤中即時監控 5/10/20MA 破線警報", "daemon": True, "sandbox": False},
    {"name": "盤後初結算排程 (16:30)", "file": "run_aftermarket_master.py", "cat": "系統維護", "desc": "呼叫 sp_RunDailyAfterMarket_Master 8步刷新", "daemon": False, "sandbox": False},
    {"name": "安全網終極校正 (22:30)", "file": "nightly_audit.py", "cat": "系統維護", "desc": "校對資料完整度 ✕ 清理日誌快取", "daemon": False, "sandbox": False},
]

RUNNING_PROCESSES = {}
LOG_HISTORY = []

def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "🌟 Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦 V2.3 (沙盒開放 ✕ 實戰防護版)"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.bgcolor = "#080f1a"
    page.padding = 18

    lock_status_icon = ft.Icon(ft.Icons.LOCK, color="#ef4444", size=24, tooltip="作戰武器已鎖定 (訪客可使用綠色開放體驗區)")
    
    commander_key_input = ft.TextField(
        password=True,
        can_reveal_password=True,
        hint_text="🔑 輸入長官密碼以解鎖【需授權】作戰武器...",
        width=320,
        height=40,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border_color="#1e293b",
        focused_border_color="#eab308",
        color="#e2e8f0"
    )

    filter_switch = ft.Switch(label="🎯 僅顯示關鍵戰報", value=True)

    console_column = ft.Column(spacing=3, scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO)
    console_container = ft.Container(
        content=console_column,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b"),
        border_radius=8,
        padding=12,
        height=300,
        expand=True
    )

    def evaluate_critical_info(raw_text):
        if "收到用戶指令" in raw_text or "用戶" in raw_text:
            return True, "#c084fc"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚨", "❌", "錯誤", "error", "exception", "traceback", "409", "conflict", "終止", "攔截"]):
            return True, "#ef4444"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["✅", "🏁", "成功", "完成", "更新", "報酬率", "勝率", "年化", "授權通過", "沙盒體驗啟動"]):
            return True, "#22c55e"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚀", "📡", "發射指令", "進程已鎖定", "安全核准"]):
            return True, "#38bdf8"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🔥", "⭐", "突破", "金叉", "共振", "解盤", "伏兵", "🎮"]):
            return True, "#facc15"
        return False, "#64748b"

    def refresh_console_ui():
        console_column.controls.clear()
        only_critical = filter_switch.value
        for text, is_crit, color in LOG_HISTORY[-200:]:
            if only_critical and not is_crit:
                continue
            console_column.controls.append(ft.Text(text, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas"))
        page.update()
        try:
            console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def log(msg):
        is_crit, color = evaluate_critical_info(msg)
        LOG_HISTORY.append((msg, is_crit, color))
        if not filter_switch.value or is_crit:
            console_column.controls.append(ft.Text(msg, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas"))
            page.update()
            try:
                console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def show_alert(msg, color="#ef4444"):
        try:
            snack = ft.SnackBar(ft.Text(msg, color="#ffffff"), bgcolor=color)
            if hasattr(page, "open"):
                page.open(snack)
            else:
                page.snack_bar = snack
                page.snack_bar.open = True
                page.update()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def on_key_change(e):
        if e.control.value == MASTER_PASSWORD:
            lock_status_icon.icon = ft.Icons.LOCK_OPEN
            lock_status_icon.color = "#22c55e"
            lock_status_icon.tooltip = "長官身分認證成功 (全區武器已完全解鎖)"
            log("🔓 [安全核准] 指揮官身分驗證通過！全生態系實戰武器已解鎖！")
            show_alert("🔓 指揮官身分驗證成功！實戰武器已全部解鎖！", color="#22c55e")
        else:
            lock_status_icon.icon = ft.Icons.LOCK
            lock_status_icon.color = "#ef4444"
            lock_status_icon.tooltip = "作戰武器已鎖定 (訪客可使用綠色開放體驗區)"
        page.update()

    commander_key_input.on_change = on_key_change
    filter_switch.on_change = lambda e: refresh_console_ui()

    def clear_console(e):
        LOG_HISTORY.clear()
        console_column.controls.clear()
        log("📡 [終端已重置] 等待戰情指令...")

    # 🚀 進程發射調度器 (沙盒 vs 需密碼 雙軌判斷)
    def run_script(item, status_btn):
        file_name = item["file"]
        is_sandbox = item.get("sandbox", False)

        # 🚨 若不是沙盒體驗程式，強制檢查長官密碼！
        if not is_sandbox:
            if commander_key_input.value != MASTER_PASSWORD:
                log(f"🚨 [安全防禦攔截] 【{file_name}】為指揮官專屬作戰武器！未授權操作已被拒絕！")
                show_alert("⚠️ 這是指揮官專屬作戰武器！若想體驗，請點選上方【🎮 開放體驗 (免密碼)】專區！", color="#ef4444")
                return

        if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
            log(f"🛑 [強制煞車] 正在終止: {file_name} (PID: {RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].pid}) ...")
            try:
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].terminate()
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"⚠️ 終止失敗: {e}")
            return

        def worker():
            full_path = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, file_name)
            if is_sandbox:
                log(f"\n🎮 [沙盒體驗啟動] 正在喚醒免密碼體驗程式: {file_name} ...")
            else:
                log(f"\n🚀 [實戰指令發射] 正在以無緩衝管道喚醒作戰部隊: {file_name} ...")
            
            status_btn.text = "🛑 強制終止"
            status_btn.bgcolor = "#ef4444"
            page.update()

            env = os.environ.copy()
            env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

            try:
                cmd = [sys.executable, "-u", full_path] if file_name.endswith(".py") else [full_path]
                process = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    text=True,
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="replace",
                    cwd=SCRIPT_DIR,
                    env=env,
                    shell=False
                )
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name] = process
                log(f"📡 [進程已鎖定] {file_name} 啟動成功，PID: {process.pid}")

                for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
                    if line:
                        log(f"[{file_name}] {line.strip()}")
                
                process.wait()
                log(f"🏁 [{file_name}] 進程結束，Exit Code: {process.returncode}\n")
            except Exception as ex:
                log(f"❌ 執行異常: {ex}\n")
            finally:
                if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
                    del RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name]
                status_btn.text = "🎮 立即試玩" if is_sandbox else "立即發射"
                status_btn.bgcolor = "#10b981" if is_sandbox else "#0284c7"
                page.update()

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    cards_container = ft.ResponsiveRow([])
    current_filter = {"cat": "全部", "query": ""}

    def build_cards():
        cards_container.controls.clear()
        query = current_filter["query"].lower()
        selected_cat = current_filter["cat"]

        filtered_list = []
        for s in PYTHON_SCRIPTS:
            if selected_cat == "開放體驗":
                cat_match = s.get("sandbox", False)
            elif selected_cat == "全部":
                cat_match = True
            else:
                cat_match = (s["cat"] == selected_cat)

            query_match = (query in s["name"].lower()) or (query in s["file"].lower()) or (query in s["desc"].lower())
            if cat_match and query_match:
                filtered_list.append(s)

        for item in filtered_list:
            f = item["file"]
            is_daemon = item.get("daemon", False)
            is_sandbox = item.get("sandbox", False)
            is_running = f in RUNNING_PROCESSES

            # 按鈕配色：沙盒體驗用翠綠，實戰武器用科技藍
            if is_running:
                btn_text = "🛑 強制終止"
                btn_color = "#ef4444"
                btn_icon = ft.Icons.STOP
            else:
                btn_text = "🎮 立即試玩" if is_sandbox else "立即發射"
                btn_color = "#10b981" if is_sandbox else "#0284c7"
                btn_icon = ft.Icons.PLAY_ARROW

            btn = ft.Button(
                btn_text,
                icon=btn_icon,
                bgcolor=btn_color,
                color="#ffffff"
            )
            btn.on_click = (lambda itm=item, btn_ref=btn: lambda e: run_script(itm, btn_ref))()

            # 徽章標籤
            badge_text = "🟢 免密碼開放" if is_sandbox else "🔒 需長官授權"
            badge_color = "#059669" if is_sandbox else "#d97706"
            safe_padding = ft.Padding.symmetric(horizontal=6, vertical=2) if hasattr(ft, "Padding") else 4

            card = ft.Card(
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([
                        ft.Row([
                            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.SPORTS_ESPORTS if is_sandbox else ft.Icons.TERMINAL, color="#38bdf8", size=18),
                            ft.Text(item["name"], weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#e2e8f0", size=15),
                            ft.Container(
                                content=ft.Text(badge_text, size=10, color="#ffffff", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD),
                                bgcolor=badge_color,
                                padding=safe_padding,
                                border_radius=4
                            )
                        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
                        ft.Text(f"檔案: {item['file']}", size=12, color="#94a3b8"),
                        ft.Text(item["desc"], size=11, color="#64748b", max_lines=2, overflow=ft.TextOverflow.ELLIPSIS),
                        btn
                    ]),
                    padding=12,
                    bgcolor="#111b2b",
                    border_radius=8,
                    border=ft.Border.all(1, "#059669" if is_sandbox else "#1e293b") # 沙盒卡片帶有綠色微光邊框
                )
            )
            cards_container.controls.append(ft.Container(card, col={"sm": 12, "md": 6, "lg": 4}))

        page.update()

    def on_search_change(e):
        current_filter["query"] = e.control.value
        build_cards()

    search_box = ft.TextField(
        hint_text="🔍 搜尋部隊名稱、檔案名稱 (如: screenshot, backtest, ollama)...",
        prefix_icon=ft.Icons.SEARCH,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border_color="#1e293b",
        focused_border_color="#38bdf8",
        color="#e2e8f0",
        height=45,
        on_change=on_search_change,
        expand=True
    )

    # 🌟 分類藥丸切換列 (包含亮眼的「🎮 開放體驗 (免密碼)」專區)
    categories = [
        ("🌟 全部", "全部"),
        ("🎮 開放體驗 (免密碼)", "開放體驗"),
        ("🤖 社群廣播", "社群廣播"),
        ("🏭 策略工廠", "策略工廠"),
        ("📡 數據採集", "數據採集"),
        ("📸 RPA視覺", "RPA視覺"),
        ("⚙️ 系統維護", "系統維護"),
    ]

    cat_bar = ft.Row(scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO, spacing=8)

    def select_category(cat_val):
        current_filter["cat"] = cat_val
        render_cat_bar()
        build_cards()

    def render_cat_bar():
        cat_bar.controls.clear()
        for label, val in categories:
            is_active = (current_filter["cat"] == val)
            
            # 開放體驗標籤特別給予綠色活力色系
            if val == "開放體驗":
                btn_bg = "#059669" if is_active else "#064e3b"
                btn_color = "#ffffff" if is_active else "#6ee7b7"
            else:
                btn_bg = "#0284c7" if is_active else "#111b2b"
                btn_color = "#ffffff" if is_active else "#94a3b8"

            btn = ft.Button(
                label,
                bgcolor=btn_bg,
                color=btn_color,
                on_click=lambda e, c=val: select_category(c)
            )
            cat_bar.controls.append(btn)
        page.update()

    page.add(
        ft.Row([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Icon(ft.Icons.SATELLITE_ALT, color="#38bdf8", size=28),
                ft.Text("Zen AI 97 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
            ]),
            ft.Row([
                lock_status_icon,
                commander_key_input

RUNNING_PROCESSES = {}
LOG_HISTORY = []

def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "🌟 Zen AI 99 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦 V3.0 (全軍大檢閱)"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.bgcolor = "#080f1a"
    page.padding = 18

    lock_status_icon = ft.Icon(ft.Icons.LOCK, color="#ef4444", size=24, tooltip="作戰武器已鎖定 (訪客可使用綠色開放體驗區)")
    
    commander_key_input = ft.TextField(
        password=True,
        can_reveal_password=True,
        hint_text="🔑 輸入長官密碼以解鎖【需授權】作戰武器...",
        width=320,
        height=40,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border_color="#1e293b",
        focused_border_color="#eab308",
        color="#e2e8f0"
    )

    filter_switch = ft.Switch(label="🎯 僅顯示關鍵戰報", value=True)

    console_column = ft.Column(spacing=3, scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO)
    console_container = ft.Container(
        content=console_column,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border=ft.Border.all(1, "#1e293b"),
        border_radius=8,
        padding=12,
        height=280,
        expand=True
    )

    def evaluate_critical_info(raw_text):
        if "收到用戶指令" in raw_text or "用戶" in raw_text:
            return True, "#c084fc"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚨", "❌", "錯誤", "error", "exception", "traceback", "409", "conflict", "終止", "攔截"]):
            return True, "#ef4444"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["✅", "🏁", "成功", "完成", "更新", "報酬率", "勝率", "年化", "授權通過", "沙盒體驗啟動"]):
            return True, "#22c55e"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🚀", "📡", "發射指令", "進程已鎖定", "安全核准"]):
            return True, "#38bdf8"
        if any(w in raw_text for w in ["🔥", "⭐", "突破", "金叉", "共振", "解盤", "伏兵", "🎮", "晨會", "晨報"]):
            return True, "#facc15"
        return False, "#64748b"

    def refresh_console_ui():
        console_column.controls.clear()
        only_critical = filter_switch.value
        for text, is_crit, color in LOG_HISTORY[-200:]:
            if only_critical and not is_crit:
                continue
            console_column.controls.append(ft.Text(text, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas"))
        page.update()
        try:
            console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def log(msg):
        is_crit, color = evaluate_critical_info(msg)
        LOG_HISTORY.append((msg, is_crit, color))
        if not filter_switch.value or is_crit:
            console_column.controls.append(ft.Text(msg, color=color, size=12, font_family="Consolas"))
            page.update()
            try:
                console_column.scroll_to(offset=-1, duration=100)
            except Exception:
                pass

    def show_alert(msg, color="#ef4444"):
        try:
            snack = ft.SnackBar(ft.Text(msg, color="#ffffff"), bgcolor=color)
            if hasattr(page, "open"):
                page.open(snack)
            else:
                page.snack_bar = snack
                page.snack_bar.open = True
                page.update()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def on_key_change(e):
        if e.control.value == MASTER_PASSWORD:
            lock_status_icon.icon = ft.Icons.LOCK_OPEN
            lock_status_icon.color = "#22c55e"
            lock_status_icon.tooltip = "長官身分認證成功 (全區武器已完全解鎖)"
            log("🔓 [安全核准] 指揮官身分驗證通過！全生態系 99 支部隊實戰權限已全面解鎖！")
            show_alert("🔓 指揮官身分驗證成功！99 支部隊作戰權限已全部解鎖！", color="#22c55e")
        else:
            lock_status_icon.icon = ft.Icons.LOCK
            lock_status_icon.color = "#ef4444"
            lock_status_icon.tooltip = "作戰武器已鎖定 (訪客可使用綠色開放體驗區)"
        page.update()

    commander_key_input.on_change = on_key_change
    filter_switch.on_change = lambda e: refresh_console_ui()

    def clear_console(e):
        LOG_HISTORY.clear()
        console_column.controls.clear()
        log("📡 [終端已重置] 等待戰情指令...")

    # 🚀 進程發射調度器
    def run_script(item, status_btn):
        file_name = item["file"]
        is_sandbox = item.get("sandbox", False)

        # 非沙盒體驗程式，強制檢查長官密碼！
        if not is_sandbox:
            if commander_key_input.value != MASTER_PASSWORD:
                log(f"🚨 [安全防禦攔截] 【{file_name}】為指揮官專屬作戰武器！未授權操作已被拒絕！")
                show_alert("⚠️ 這是指揮官專屬作戰武器！若想體驗，請點選上方【🎮 開放體驗 (10支)】專區！", color="#ef4444")
                return

        if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
            log(f"🛑 [強制煞車] 正在終止: {file_name} (PID: {RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].pid}) ...")
            try:
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name].terminate()
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"⚠️ 終止失敗: {e}")
            return

        def worker():
            full_path = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, file_name)
            if is_sandbox:
                log(f"\n🎮 [沙盒體驗啟動] 正在喚醒免密碼體驗程式: {file_name} ...")
            else:
                log(f"\n🚀 [實戰指令發射] 正在以無緩衝管道喚醒作戰部隊: {file_name} ...")
            
            status_btn.text = "🛑 強制終止"
            status_btn.bgcolor = "#ef4444"
            page.update()

            env = os.environ.copy()
            env["PYTHONUNBUFFERED"] = "1"

            try:
                cmd = [sys.executable, "-u", full_path] if file_name.endswith(".py") else [full_path]
                process = subprocess.Popen(
                    cmd,
                    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    text=True,
                    encoding="utf-8",
                    errors="replace",
                    cwd=SCRIPT_DIR,
                    env=env,
                    shell=False
                )
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name] = process
                log(f"📡 [進程已鎖定] {file_name} 啟動成功，PID: {process.pid}")

                for line in iter(process.stdout.readline, ''):
                    if line:
                        log(f"[{file_name}] {line.strip()}")
                
                process.wait()
                log(f"🏁 [{file_name}] 進程結束，Exit Code: {process.returncode}\n")
            except Exception as ex:
                log(f"❌ 執行異常: {ex}\n")
            finally:
                if file_name in RUNNING_PROCESSES:
                    del RUNNING_PROCESSES[file_name]
                status_btn.text = "🎮 立即試玩" if is_sandbox else "立即發射"
                status_btn.bgcolor = "#10b981" if is_sandbox else "#0284c7"
                page.update()

        threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()

    cards_container = ft.ResponsiveRow([])
    current_filter = {"cat": "全部", "query": ""}

    def build_cards():
        cards_container.controls.clear()
        query = current_filter["query"].lower()
        selected_cat = current_filter["cat"]

        filtered_list = []
        for s in PYTHON_SCRIPTS:
            if selected_cat == "開放體驗":
                cat_match = s.get("sandbox", False)
            elif selected_cat == "全部":
                cat_match = True
            else:
                cat_match = (s["cat"] == selected_cat)

            query_match = (query in s["name"].lower()) or (query in s["file"].lower()) or (query in s["desc"].lower())
            if cat_match and query_match:
                filtered_list.append(s)

        for item in filtered_list:
            f = item["file"]
            is_daemon = item.get("daemon", False)
            is_sandbox = item.get("sandbox", False)
            is_running = f in RUNNING_PROCESSES

            if is_running:
                btn_text = "🛑 強制終止"
                btn_color = "#ef4444"
                btn_icon = ft.Icons.STOP
            else:
                btn_text = "🎮 立即試玩" if is_sandbox else "立即發射"
                btn_color = "#10b981" if is_sandbox else "#0284c7"
                btn_icon = ft.Icons.PLAY_ARROW

            btn = ft.Button(
                btn_text,
                icon=btn_icon,
                bgcolor=btn_color,
                color="#ffffff"
            )
            btn.on_click = (lambda itm=item, btn_ref=btn: lambda e: run_script(itm, btn_ref))()

            badge_text = "🟢 免密碼開放" if is_sandbox else "🔒 需長官授權"
            badge_color = "#059669" if is_sandbox else "#d97706"
            safe_padding = ft.Padding.symmetric(horizontal=6, vertical=2) if hasattr(ft, "Padding") else 4

            card = ft.Card(
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([
                        ft.Row([
                            ft.Icon(ft.Icons.SPORTS_ESPORTS if is_sandbox else ft.Icons.TERMINAL, color="#38bdf8", size=18),
                            ft.Text(item["name"], weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#e2e8f0", size=14),
                            ft.Container(
                                content=ft.Text(badge_text, size=10, color="#ffffff", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD),
                                bgcolor=badge_color,
                                padding=safe_padding,
                                border_radius=4
                            )
                        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
                        ft.Text(f"檔案: {item['file']}", size=11, color="#94a3b8"),
                        ft.Text(item["desc"], size=11, color="#64748b", max_lines=2, overflow=ft.TextOverflow.ELLIPSIS),
                        btn
                    ]),
                    padding=10,
                    bgcolor="#111b2b",
                    border_radius=8,
                    border=ft.Border.all(1, "#059669" if is_sandbox else "#1e293b")
                )
            )
            cards_container.controls.append(ft.Container(card, col={"sm": 12, "md": 6, "lg": 4}))

        page.update()

    def on_search_change(e):
        current_filter["query"] = e.control.value
        build_cards()

    search_box = ft.TextField(
        hint_text="🔍 搜尋 99 支部隊 (如: 晨報, 2330, screenshot, backtest, ollama, gps)...",
        prefix_icon=ft.Icons.SEARCH,
        bgcolor="#0c1827",
        border_color="#1e293b",
        focused_border_color="#38bdf8",
        color="#e2e8f0",
        height=45,
        on_change=on_search_change,
        expand=True
    )

    # 🌟 7 大戰術集群分類藥丸
    categories = [
        ("🌟 全部 (99支)", "全部"),
        ("🎮 開放體驗 (10支)", "開放體驗"),
        ("🤖 社群與AI (18支)", "社群與AI"),
        ("🏭 策略工廠 (8支)", "策略工廠"),
        ("📡 數據採集 (17支)", "數據採集"),
        ("📥 資料庫匯入 (10支)", "資料庫匯入"),
        ("🧠 本地AI與基因 (8支)", "本地AI與基因"),
        ("🛠️ 輔助與周邊 (28支)", "輔助與周邊"),
    ]

    cat_bar = ft.Row(scroll=ft.ScrollMode.AUTO, spacing=8)

    def select_category(cat_val):
        current_filter["cat"] = cat_val
        render_cat_bar()
        build_cards()

    def render_cat_bar():
        cat_bar.controls.clear()
        for label, val in categories:
            is_active = (current_filter["cat"] == val)
            if val == "開放體驗":
                btn_bg = "#059669" if is_active else "#064e3b"
                btn_color = "#ffffff" if is_active else "#6ee7b7"
            else:
                btn_bg = "#0284c7" if is_active else "#111b2b"
                btn_color = "#ffffff" if is_active else "#94a3b8"

            btn = ft.Button(
                label,
                bgcolor=btn_bg,
                color=btn_color,
                on_click=lambda e, c=val: select_category(c)
            )
            cat_bar.controls.append(btn)
        page.update()

    page.add(
        ft.Row([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Icon(ft.Icons.SATELLITE_ALT, color="#38bdf8", size=28),
                ft.Text("Zen AI 99 部隊大一統中樞指揮母艦", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
            ]),
            ft.Row([
                lock_status_icon,
                commander_key_input
            ])
        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b"),
        ft.Row([search_box]),
        cat_bar,
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b", height=10),
        cards_container,
        ft.Divider(color="#1e293b"),
        ft.Row([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Icon(ft.Icons.MONITOR_HEART, color="#22c55e", size=18),
                ft.Text("📡 即時輸出終端 (Live Telemetry)", size=15, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38bdf8"),
            ]),
            ft.Row([
                filter_switch,
                ft.Button("清空日誌", icon=ft.Icons.CLEAR_ALL, bgcolor="#334155", color="#ffffff", on_click=clear_console)
            ])
        ], alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.SPACE_BETWEEN),
        console_container
    )

    render_cat_bar()
    build_cards()
    log("🎮 [沙盒大閱兵就緒] 長官欽點【08:30 晨會作戰晨報】等 10 大開放體驗部隊已上線！任何人皆可自由點擊試玩！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if hasattr(ft, "run"):
        try:
            ft.run(main, port=8550, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
        except TypeError:
            ft.run(main)
    else:
        ft.app(target=main, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER, port=8550)
