OPENROUTER_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

# 🟢 關鍵修正 1：將具備 8K 超長輸出的 Gemini 與 Llama 70B 移至第一優先，徹底避開 512 字限制！
MODEL_TIERS = [
    ("google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free", "⚡ Gemini 2.0 Flash (8K超長輸出/零截斷)"),
    ("meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free", "👑 Llama-3.3 70B (開源最強推理)"),
    ("qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct:free", "💎 Qwen-2.5-Coder (32B 量化專用)"),
    ("openrouter/free", "🌐 OpenRouter 官方動態分流"),
    ("inclusionai/ling-3.0-flash:free", "📈 Ling-3.0-Flash (104B 金融專用)")
]

def fetch_omni_data(stock_code):
    """從全知大寬表抓取唯一量化特徵"""
    clean_code = str(stock_code).replace('.0', '').strip()
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql)
            
            columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return None
            return dict(zip(columns, row))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫查詢異常: {e}")
        return None

def build_strict_prompt(stock_data):
    """建構防幻覺 (Anti-Hallucination) 嚴格約束提示詞"""
    context_json = json.dumps(stock_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    prompt = f"""你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請根據以下【View_AI_Omni_Context 全知量化寬表】的唯一真實數據，為【{stock_data['名稱']}({stock_data['代號']})】進行具體客觀的深度戰術解盤：

【最高行動鐵律 / Anti-Hallucination Rules】：
1. 你的所有判斷必須 100% 基於下方的 JSON 數據，嚴禁猜測、腦補未提供的新聞或數據。
2. 若「籌碼共振熱度」為負數 (如 -14/32)，代表處於空頭死亡交叉或法人連續賣超狀態；正數則為多頭。
3. 語氣專業、一針見血、殺伐果斷，全部使用繁體中文。
4. 請務必完整寫完三個章節並給出具體結論，不得中途停止。

【量化全知數據庫】：
{context_json}

請嚴格依照下列結構輸出戰報：
### 一、🎯 位階基因與動態乖離
(分析股本基因、現價、月線乖離率與「乖離戰術判定」)

### 二、🧱 3D AMT 價值區微結構
(分析 20日短線/60日季線/240日年線主力成本、空間判定與上方壓力/下方支撐)

### 三、⚡ 籌碼熱度與綜合實戰指引
(綜合籌碼共振熱度，給出明確的進攻/防守/停損點與資金配置結論)"""
    return prompt

def call_openrouter_5tier(prompt_text):
    """呼叫 OpenRouter 模型 (內建防截斷探針 ✕ 自動換人重試)"""
    if not OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
        return "❌ 錯誤：無法在系統中自動探針到 OpenRouter API 金鑰。"

    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🧠 正在調用大模型 【{model_name}】 進行全知深度推理...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500 # 🟢 釋放充足額度
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    msg_obj = choice["message"]
                    finish_reason = choice.get("finish_reason", "")
                    
                    # 🟢 關鍵修正 2：防截斷探針！若模型回報 length (因字數上限腰斬)，自動換下一家！
                    if finish_reason == "length":
                        print(f"⚠️ 模型 {model_name} 因免費額度限制導致輸出截斷，自動切換至下一模型獲取完整報告...")
                        last_err = f"{model_name} (輸出遭截斷)"
                        continue

                    content = msg_obj.get("content") or msg_obj.get("reasoning") or ""
                    
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        
                        if clean_content and len(clean_content) > 100:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return f"└─ 成功由大腦【🌐 {actual_model}】產出完整戰報！\n\n{clean_content}"
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ OpenRouter 全數輪詢失敗，最後錯誤: {last_err}"

# =========================================================================
# 🚀 主程式入口
# =========================================================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Zen AI 全知解盤發射器")
    parser.add_argument("--code", type=str, default="2317", help="股票代號")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    clean_code = str(args.code).replace('.0', '').strip()

        print("═" * 70)

    else:

# 🔑 3. 智慧金鑰自動探針 (自動繼承現有腳本金鑰)

def auto_detect_tokens():
    gemini_keys = []
    openrouter_key = ""
    
    # 探針目標檔案清單
    files = ["zen_ai_bot2.py", "zen_ai_bot1.py", "update_notioninfo_OpenRouter.py", "chart_explain.py"]
    for fname in files:
        fpath = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, fname)
        if os.path.exists(fpath):
            try:
                with open(fpath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                    # 抓取 Google Gemini 金鑰 (AIzaSy 開頭)
                    g_matches = re.findall(r'["\'](AIzaSy[A-Za-z0-9_-]{33})["\']', content)
                    if g_matches:
                        gemini_keys.extend(g_matches)
                    
                    # 抓取 OpenRouter 金鑰 (sk-or-v1- 開頭)
                    if not openrouter_key:
                        or_match = re.search(r'(sk-or-v1-[A-Za-z0-9a-f]+)', content)
                        if or_match:
                            openrouter_key = or_match.group(1)
            except Exception:
                pass

    # 備用保底金鑰
    if not openrouter_key:
        openrouter_key = "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"

    return list(dict.fromkeys(gemini_keys)), openrouter_key

GEMINI_API_KEYS, OPENROUTER_API_KEY = auto_detect_tokens()

def fetch_omni_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = str(stock_code).replace('.0', '').strip()
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql)
            
            columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return None
            return dict(zip(columns, row))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫查詢異常: {e}")
        return None

def build_strict_prompt(stock_data):
    """建構嚴格防幻覺提示詞 ✕ 強制輸出雙表格與總監戰令"""
    context_json = json.dumps(stock_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    prompt = f"""你是一位隸屬於「Zen AI 量化戰情室」的頂級對沖基金操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請根據以下【View_AI_Omni_Context 全知量化寬表】的唯一真實數據，為【{stock_data['名稱']}({stock_data['代號']})】進行具體客觀的深度戰術解盤：

【最高行動鐵律 / Anti-Hallucination Rules】：
1. 你的所有判斷必須 100% 基於下方的 JSON 數據，嚴禁猜測、腦補未提供的新聞或數據。
2. 若「籌碼共振熱度」為負數 (如 -14/32)，代表處於空頭死亡交叉或法人連續賣超狀態；正數則為多頭。
3. 語氣需專業、冷靜、一針見血、殺伐果斷，全部使用繁體中文。

【量化全知數據庫】：
{context_json}

請嚴格依照下列結構輸出戰報 (請務必繪製 Markdown 格式表格，切勿隨意截斷)：
### 一、🎯 位階基因與動態乖離
(分析股本基因、現價、月線乖離率與「乖離戰術判定」)

### 二、🧱 3D AMT 價值區微結構
(請務必繪製 Markdown 成本壓支結構對照表，標註 20日/60日/240日主力成本、價差%與戰術屬性，並分析空間判定)

### 三、⚡ 籌碼熱度與綜合實戰指引
(分析籌碼共振熱度負數含義，並務必繪製 Markdown「實戰戰術指令單」表格，涵蓋進攻、防守減碼、停損停利與資金配置建議)

(以一段精煉霸氣、直指死生的戰略總結收尾，給出當下最正確動作)"""
    return prompt

# 🚀 5. 雙引擎通訊調度核心 (Gemini 官方 ➔ OpenRouter 備援)

def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    """【第一階梯】直連 Google 原廠 API (超高速、8K輸出、無截斷)"""
    global _working_gemini_model
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        return None

    # 若已有確認可用的模型，優先嘗試
    candidates = GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    if _working_gemini_model:
        candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in candidates if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            print(f"👑 正在調用 Google 原廠大腦 【{model_name}】...")
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                "generationConfig": {
                    "temperature": 0.25,
                    "maxOutputTokens": 3000
                }
            }
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    res_json = r.json()
                    candidates_out = res_json.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        content = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 150:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            return f"└─ 成功由原廠大腦【{model_name}】產出深度解盤！\n\n{content}"
                elif r.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 配額已滿 (429)，自動切換金鑰/備援...")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 回應 {r.status_code}，切換備援...")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 連線 {model_name} 異常: {e}，切換備援...")
                continue
    return None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    """【第二階梯】OpenRouter 5 重輪詢備援鏈"""
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🌐 正在啟動 OpenRouter 雲端備援 【{model_name}】...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    if choice.get("finish_reason") == "length":
                        continue
                    
                    content = choice["message"].get("content") or choice["message"].get("reasoning") or ""
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        
                        if len(clean_content) > 150:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return f"└─ 成功由雲端大腦【{actual_model}】產出深度解盤！\n\n{clean_content}"
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ 所有雙引擎通道皆無回應，最後錯誤: {last_err}"

def generate_omni_report(prompt_text):
    """雙引擎總調度：Gemini 原廠優先 ➔ OpenRouter 無縫接管"""
    # 1. 優先嘗試 Google 官方原廠真身
    report = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
    if report:
        return report

    print("⚡ Google 原廠通道暫時滿載，0 秒無感切換至 OpenRouter 雲端集群！")
    # 2. 自動切換 OpenRouter 備援
    return call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)

"""

GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES = [

def auto_detect_tokens():
    gemini_keys = []
    openrouter_key = ""
    
    files = ["zen_ai_bot2.py", "zen_ai_bot1.py", "update_notioninfo_OpenRouter.py", "chart_explain.py"]
    for fname in files:
        fpath = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, fname)
        if os.path.exists(fpath):
            try:
                with open(fpath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                    
                    # 1. 抓取 Google AI Studio 金鑰 (AIza 開頭之 39 碼字串)
                    g_matches = re.findall(r'AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35}', content)
                    if g_matches:
                        gemini_keys.extend(g_matches)
                    
                    # 2. 抓取陣列寫法 GEMINI_API_KEYS = [...] 或 GEMINI_KEYS = [...]
                    array_match = re.search(r'GEMINI(?:_API)?_KEYS?\s*=\s*(\[[^\]]+\])', content)
                    if array_match:
                        raw_keys = re.findall(r'["\']([^"\']+)["\']', array_match.group(1))
                        gemini_keys.extend([k for k in raw_keys if len(k) > 20])
                    
                    # 3. 抓取 OpenRouter 金鑰
                    if not openrouter_key:
                        or_match = re.search(r'(sk-or-v1-[A-Za-z0-9a-f]+)', content)
                        if or_match:
                            openrouter_key = or_match.group(1)
            except Exception:
                pass

    if not openrouter_key:
        openrouter_key = "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"

    # 去重
    unique_gemini = list(dict.fromkeys(gemini_keys))
    return unique_gemini, openrouter_key

def fetch_omni_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = str(stock_code).replace('.0', '').strip()
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql)
            
            columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return None
            return dict(zip(columns, row))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫查詢異常: {e}")
        return None

def build_strict_prompt(stock_data):
    """建構嚴格防幻覺提示詞 ✕ 強制輸出雙表格與總監戰令"""
    context_json = json.dumps(stock_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    prompt = f"""你是一位隸屬於「Zen AI 量化戰情室」的頂級對沖基金操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請根據以下【View_AI_Omni_Context 全知量化寬表】的唯一真實數據，為【{stock_data['名稱']}({stock_data['代號']})】進行具體客觀的深度戰術解盤：

【最高行動鐵律 / Anti-Hallucination Rules】：
1. 你的所有判斷必須 100% 基於下方的 JSON 數據，嚴禁猜測、腦補未提供的新聞或數據。
2. 若「籌碼共振熱度」為負數 (如 -14/32)，代表處於空頭死亡交叉或法人連續賣超狀態；正數則為多頭。
3. 語氣需專業、冷靜、一針見血、殺伐果斷，全部使用繁體中文。

【量化全知數據庫】：
{context_json}

請嚴格依照下列結構輸出戰報 (請務必繪製 Markdown 格式表格，切勿隨意截斷)：

(分析股本基因、現價、月線乖離率與「乖離戰術判定」)

### 二、🧱 3D AMT 價值區微結構
(請務必繪製 Markdown 成本壓支結構對照表，標註 20日/60日/240日主力成本、價差%與戰術屬性，並分析空間判定)

### 三、⚡ 籌碼熱度與綜合實戰指引
(分析籌碼共振熱度負數含義，並務必繪製 Markdown「實戰戰術指令單」表格，涵蓋進攻、防守減碼、停損停利與資金配置建議)

(以一段精煉霸氣、直指死生的戰略總結收尾，給出當下最正確動作)"""
    return prompt

# 🚀 5. 雙引擎通訊調度核心 (Gemini 官方 ➔ OpenRouter 備援)
# =========================================================================
def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    """【第一階梯】直連 Google 原廠 API"""
    global _working_gemini_model
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        return None

    candidates = GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    if _working_gemini_model:
        candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in candidates if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            print(f"👑 正在調用 Google 原廠大腦 【{model_name}】...")
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                "generationConfig": {
                    "temperature": 0.25,
                    "maxOutputTokens": 3000
                }
            }
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    res_json = r.json()
                    candidates_out = res_json.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        content = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 150:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            return f"└─ 成功由原廠大腦【{model_name}】產出深度解盤！\n\n{content}"
                elif r.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 配額已滿 (429)，切換下一組金鑰...")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 回應 {r.status_code}，切換備援...")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 連線 {model_name} 異常: {e}，切換備援...")
                continue
    return None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    """【第二階梯】OpenRouter 備援鏈 (已保證 OPENROUTER_URL 正常)"""
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🌐 正在啟動 OpenRouter 雲端備援 【{model_name}】...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    if choice.get("finish_reason") == "length":
                        continue
                    
                    content = choice["message"].get("content") or choice["message"].get("reasoning") or ""
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        
                        if len(clean_content) > 150:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return f"└─ 成功由雲端大腦【{actual_model}】產出深度解盤！\n\n{clean_content}"
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ 所有雙引擎通道皆無回應，最後錯誤: {last_err}"

def generate_omni_report(prompt_text):
    """雙引擎總調度"""
    if GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        print(f"🔑 已探針到 {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 組 Google 原廠金鑰，啟動第一階梯直連...")
        report = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
        if report:
            return report
        print("⚡ Google 原廠通道暫時滿載，0 秒無感切換至 OpenRouter 雲端集群！")
    else:
        print("💡 未探針到 Google 原廠金鑰，直接啟用 OpenRouter 旗艦集群...")

    return call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)

# 🌐 【第二階梯】：OpenRouter 備援模型池
OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS = [
    ("meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free", "👑 Llama-3.3 70B (開源最強推理)"),
    ("google/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:free",       "⚡ Gemini 2.0 Flash (8K超長輸出)"),
    ("qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct:free", "💎 Qwen-2.5-Coder (32B 量化專用)"),
    ("openrouter/free",                        "🌐 OpenRouter 官方動態分流")
]

_working_gemini_model = None

# =========================================================================
# 🔑 3. 智慧金鑰自動探針 (深度掃描 zen_ai_bot2.py 等核心腳本)
# =========================================================================
def auto_detect_tokens():
    gemini_keys = []
    openrouter_key = ""
    
    files = ["zen_ai_bot2.py", "zen_ai_bot1.py", "update_notioninfo_OpenRouter.py", "chart_explain.py"]
    for fname in files:
        fpath = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, fname)
        if os.path.exists(fpath):
            try:
                with open(fpath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                    
                    # 1. 抓取 Google AI Studio 金鑰
                    g_matches = re.findall(r'AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35}', content)
                    if g_matches:
                        gemini_keys.extend(g_matches)
                    
                    # 2. 抓取陣列寫法 GEMINI_API_KEYS = [...]
                    array_match = re.search(r'GEMINI(?:_API)?_KEYS?\s*=\s*(\[[^\]]+\])', content)
                    if array_match:
                        raw_keys = re.findall(r'["\']([^"\']+)["\']', array_match.group(1))
                        gemini_keys.extend([k for k in raw_keys if len(k) > 20])
                    
                    # 3. 抓取 OpenRouter 金鑰
                    if not openrouter_key:
                        or_match = re.search(r'(sk-or-v1-[A-Za-z0-9a-f]+)', content)
                        if or_match:
                            openrouter_key = or_match.group(1)
            except Exception:
                pass

    if not openrouter_key:
        openrouter_key = "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"

    unique_gemini = list(dict.fromkeys(gemini_keys))
    return unique_gemini, openrouter_key

GEMINI_API_KEYS, OPENROUTER_API_KEY = auto_detect_tokens()

# =========================================================================
# 🗄️ 4. 全知大寬表資料調度
# =========================================================================
def fetch_omni_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = str(stock_code).replace('.0', '').strip()
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql)
            
            columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            
            if not row:
                return None
            return dict(zip(columns, row))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 資料庫查詢異常: {e}")
        return None

def build_strict_prompt(stock_data):
    """建構嚴格防幻覺提示詞 ✕ 強制輸出雙表格與總監戰令"""
    context_json = json.dumps(stock_data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    prompt = f"""你是一位隸屬於「Zen AI 量化戰情室」的頂級對沖基金操盤總監與首席技術分析師。
請根據以下【View_AI_Omni_Context 全知量化寬表】的唯一真實數據，為【{stock_data['名稱']}({stock_data['代號']})】進行具體客觀的深度戰術解盤：

【最高行動鐵律 / Anti-Hallucination Rules】：
1. 你的所有判斷必須 100% 基於下方的 JSON 數據，嚴禁猜測、腦補未提供的新聞或數據。
2. 若「籌碼共振熱度」為負數 (如 -14/32)，代表處於空頭死亡交叉或法人連續賣超狀態；正數則為多頭。
3. 語氣需專業、冷靜、一針見血、殺伐果斷，全部使用繁體中文。

【量化全知數據庫】：
{context_json}

請嚴格依照下列結構輸出戰報 (請務必繪製 Markdown 格式表格，切勿隨意截斷)：
### 一、🎯 位階基因與動態乖離
(分析股本基因、現價、月線乖離率與「乖離戰術判定」)

### 二、🧱 3D AMT 價值區微結構
(請務必繪製 Markdown 成本壓支結構對照表，標註 20日/60日/240日主力成本、價差%與戰術屬性，並分析空間判定)

### 三、⚡ 籌碼熱度與綜合實戰指引
(分析籌碼共振熱度含義，並務必繪製 Markdown「實戰戰術指令單」表格，涵蓋進攻點、防守點、停損停利與資金配置建議)

---

(以一段精煉霸氣、直指死生的戰略總結收尾，給出當下最正確動作)"""
    return prompt

# =========================================================================
# 🚀 5. 雙引擎通訊調度核心 (回傳內容與成功之模型名稱)
# =========================================================================
def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    """【第一階梯】直連 Google 原廠 API"""
    global _working_gemini_model
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        return None, None

    candidates = GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    if _working_gemini_model:
        candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in candidates if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            print(f"👑 正在調用 Google 原廠大腦 【{model_name}】...")
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                "generationConfig": {
                    "temperature": 0.25,
                    "maxOutputTokens": 3000
                }
            }
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    res_json = r.json()
                    candidates_out = res_json.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        content = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 150:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 配額已滿 (429)，切換下一組金鑰...")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 回應 {r.status_code}，切換備援...")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 連線 {model_name} 異常: {e}，切換備援...")
                continue
    return None, None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    """【第二階梯】OpenRouter 備援鏈"""
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🌐 正在啟動 OpenRouter 雲端備援 【{model_name}】...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    if choice.get("finish_reason") == "length":
                        continue
                    
                    content = choice["message"].get("content") or choice["message"].get("reasoning") or ""
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        
                        if len(clean_content) > 150:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return clean_content, actual_model
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ 所有雙引擎通道皆無回應，最後錯誤: {last_err}", "全數繁忙"

def generate_omni_report(prompt_text):
    """雙引擎總調度 (回傳 報告本文, 實際產出大腦)"""
    if GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        print(f"🔑 已探針到 {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 組 Google 原廠金鑰，啟動第一階梯直連...")
        content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
        if content:
            return content, model_name
        print("⚡ Google 原廠通道暫時滿載，0 秒無感切換至 OpenRouter 雲端集群！")
    else:
        print("💡 未探針到 Google 原廠金鑰，直接啟用 OpenRouter 旗艦集群...")

    return call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)

def clean_stock_code(code_val):
    if not code_val: return ""
    c_str = str(code_val).strip()
    if c_str.endswith(".0"): c_str = c_str[:-2]
    return c_str

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    payload = {"message": message_text}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=2)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, timeout=2)
    except Exception: pass

def fetch_omni_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql)
            columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if not row: return None
            return dict(zip(columns, row))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 全知大寬表查詢異常: {e}")
        return None

def build_omni_prompt(stock_data):

請根據以下【View_AI_Omni_Context 全知量化寬表】的唯一真實數據，為【{stock_data['名稱']}({stock_data['代號']})】進行具體客觀的深度戰術解盤：

【最高行動鐵律 / Anti-Hallucination Rules】：
1. 你的所有判斷必須 100% 基於下方的 JSON 數據，嚴禁猜測、腦補未提供的新聞或數據。
2. 若「籌碼共振熱度」為負數 (如 -14/32)，代表處於空頭死亡交叉或法人連續賣超狀態；正數則為多頭。
3. 語氣需專業、冷靜、一針見血、殺伐果斷，全部使用繁體中文。

【量化全知數據庫】：
{context_json}

# 🧠 3. 雙引擎大腦調度 (Gemini 原廠 ➔ OpenRouter 備援 ➔ 嚴格防截斷)

def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS: return None, None
    candidates = GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    if _working_gemini_model:
        candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in candidates if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            print(f"👑 正在調用 Google 原廠大腦 【{model_name}】...")
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.25, "maxOutputTokens": 3500}
            }
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    res_json = r.json()
                    candidates_out = res_json.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        content = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 150:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 配額已滿 (429)，切換下一組金鑰...")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 回應 {r.status_code}，切換備援...")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 連線 {model_name} 異常: {e}，切換備援...")
                continue
    return None, None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🌐 正在啟動 OpenRouter 雲端備援 【{model_name}】...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    if choice.get("finish_reason") == "length": continue
                    content = choice["message"].get("content") or choice["message"].get("reasoning") or ""
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        if len(clean_content) > 150:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return clean_content, actual_model
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ 所有雙引擎通道皆無回應，最後錯誤: {last_err}", "全數繁忙"

def generate_omni_analysis(stock_data):
    prompt_text = build_omni_prompt(stock_data)
    if GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
        if content: return content, model_name
        print("⚡ Google 原廠通道暫時滿載，0 秒無感切換至 OpenRouter 雲端集群！")
    return call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)

async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = clean_stock_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    print(f"🚀 Playwright 前往網址 (截圖專用): {url}")

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=35000)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

            current_hour_min = int(today.strftime("%H%M"))
            is_live_hours = (current_hour_min >= 900 and current_hour_min <= 1335)
            btn_target = page.locator("#btn_query_live, #btn_query_realtime") if is_live_hours else page.locator("#btn_query_post")

            if await btn_target.count() > 0 and await btn_target.is_visible():
                await btn_target.first.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動') || el.textContent.includes('即時'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(3.5)
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            print(f"✅ 截圖成功！")
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id
    user_name = message.from_user.first_name or "使用者"

    print(f"\n📩 [收到用戶指令] {user_name}: 「{raw_text}」")

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 核心全新分支：問號觸發【全知大寬表解盤】(2330? / 2330?? / 2330全知)
    # =====================================================================
    is_omni_with_photo = bool(re.search(r'(\?\?|？？|全知圖片|全知圖)', raw_text))
    is_omni_text_only = bool(re.search(r'(\?|？|全知)', raw_text)) and not is_omni_with_photo

    if is_omni_text_only or is_omni_with_photo:
        # 提取股票代號
        target_stock = re.sub(r'(\?\?|？？|\?|？|全知圖片|全知圖|全知)', '', raw_text).strip()
        target_stock = clean_stock_code(target_stock)

        if not target_stock:
            bot.reply_to(message, "💡 全知指令範例：`2330?` (極速戰報) 或 `2330??` (戰報＋圖表大滿貫)")
            return

        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在穿透 View_AI_Omni_Context 全知大寬表，調用雙引擎大腦為【{target_stock}】生成頂級量化戰報...")

        stock_data = fetch_omni_data(target_stock)
        if not stock_data:
            bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 資料庫查無股票【{target_stock}】的全知寬表數據！請確認代號是否正確。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 啟動大模型運算
        analysis, used_brain = generate_omni_analysis(stock_data)
        now_time_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')

        clean_code = str(stock_data['代號']).replace('.0', '').strip()
        clean_name = str(stock_data['名稱']).strip()

        # 組裝頂級戰報全文
        full_omni_report = (
            f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI 終極全知解盤報告\n"
            f"└─ 成功由大腦【{used_brain}】產出！\n\n"
            f"{analysis}\n\n"
            f"解盤時間: {now_time_str} ({used_brain})"
        )

        # 處理截圖 (若為雙問號模式 ??)
        photo_path = None
        if is_omni_with_photo:
            try:
                photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(clean_code))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 截圖異常: {e}")

        try:
            bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        except Exception: pass

        # 發送文字戰報 (超過 3800 字自動分段)
        if len(full_omni_report) > 3800:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_omni_report[:3800])
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_omni_report[3800:])
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_omni_report)

        send_to_line(full_omni_report)

        # 發送高清截圖

    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql)
            columns = [column[0] for column in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if not row: return None
            return dict(zip(columns, row))

def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS: return None, None
    candidates = GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    if _working_gemini_model:
        candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in candidates if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            print(f"👑 正在調用 Google 原廠大腦 【{model_name}】...")
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.25, "maxOutputTokens": 3500}
            }
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    res_json = r.json()
                    candidates_out = res_json.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        content = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 150:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 配額已滿 (429)，切換下一組金鑰...")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 回應 {r.status_code}，切換備援...")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 連線 {model_name} 異常: {e}，切換備援...")
                continue
    return None, None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🌐 正在啟動 OpenRouter 雲端備援 【{model_name}】...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    if choice.get("finish_reason") == "length": continue
                    content = choice["message"].get("content") or choice["message"].get("reasoning") or ""
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        if len(clean_content) > 150:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return clean_content, actual_model
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ 所有雙引擎通道皆無回應，最後錯誤: {last_err}", "全數繁忙"

def generate_omni_analysis(stock_data):
    prompt_text = build_omni_prompt(stock_data)
    if GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
        if content: return content, model_name
        print("⚡ Google 原廠通道暫時滿載，0 秒無感切換至 OpenRouter 雲端集群！")
    return call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)

async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    print(f"🚀 Playwright 前往截圖: {url}")

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=35000)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

            current_hour_min = int(today.strftime("%H%M"))
            is_live_hours = (current_hour_min >= 900 and current_hour_min <= 1335)
            btn_target = page.locator("#btn_query_live, #btn_query_realtime") if is_live_hours else page.locator("#btn_query_post")

            if await btn_target.count() > 0 and await btn_target.is_visible():
                await btn_target.first.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動') || el.textContent.includes('即時'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(3.5)
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            print(f"✅ 截圖成功！")
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

# 60M 金叉選股查詢
def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            return cursor.fetchall()
    except Exception: return []

def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id
    user_name = message.from_user.first_name or "使用者"

    # 全形符號自動轉半形
    raw_text = raw_text.replace('？', '?').replace('！', '!').replace('，', ',')
    print(f"\n📩 [收到用戶指令] {user_name}: 「{raw_text}」")

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 1：純問號 `?` 或 `K` ➔ 60M 金叉選股榜 (連股號都不用打！)
    # =====================================================================
    if raw_text in ["?", "k", "K", "top", "TOP", "找金叉", "選股"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵黑馬...")
        rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        if not rows:
            bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強黑馬榜】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]}\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
        
        msg += f"\n👉 手機直接打 `股號?` (例: `2454?`) 立即查看全知戰報！"
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, msg)
        return

    # 提取純數字股票代號 (徹底消滅 2454? 查無資料的 Bug)
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(raw_text)

    if not clean_code:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 快速指令範例：\n• `2330?` ➔ 極速全知戰報\n• `2330??` ➔ 戰報＋圖表大滿貫\n• `?` ➔ 60M 金叉選股")
        return

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 2：【2330?】或【2330??】➔ 全知大寬表旗艦解盤
    # =====================================================================
    is_omni_with_photo = "??" in raw_text or "全知圖" in raw_text
    is_omni_text_only = ("?" in raw_text or "全知" in raw_text) and not is_omni_with_photo

    if is_omni_text_only or is_omni_with_photo:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在穿透 View_AI_Omni_Context 全知大寬表，為【{clean_code}】生成頂級量化戰報...")

        stock_data = fetch_omni_data(clean_code)
        if not stock_data:
            bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 資料庫查無股票【{clean_code}】的資料！請確認代號是否正確。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 啟動大腦運算
        analysis, used_brain = generate_omni_analysis(stock_data)
        now_time_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')

        clean_name = str(stock_data['名稱']).strip()

        full_omni_report = (
            f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI 終極全知解盤報告\n"
            f"└─ 成功由大腦【{used_brain}】產出！\n\n"
            f"{analysis}\n\n"
            f"解盤時間: {now_time_str} ({used_brain})"
        )

        photo_path = None
        if is_omni_with_photo:
            try: photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(clean_code))
            except Exception: pass

        try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        except Exception: pass

        # 發送文字
        if len(full_omni_report) > 3800:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_omni_report[:3800])
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_omni_report[3800:])
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_omni_report)

        send_to_line(full_omni_report)

        # 發送截圖
        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            time.sleep(0.3)
            try:
                with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f: bot.send_photo(chat_id, f)
                send_to_line(f"📊 【{clean_code} {clean_name}】四大圖表", photo_path)
            except Exception: pass

        return

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 3：【2330p】➔ 純四大圖表高清截圖 (P = Photo)

    is_photo_cmd = raw_text.lower().endswith("p") or "圖" in raw_text
    if is_photo_cmd:

            send_to_line(f"📊 【{clean_code}】四大圖表", photo_path)
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 【{clean_code}】截圖生成異常。")
        return

    # =====================================================================

    ("meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free", "👑 Llama-3.3 70B (開源最強推理)"),
    ("qwen/qwen-2.5-coder-32b-instruct:free", "💎 Qwen-2.5-Coder (32B 量化專用)"),
    ("openrouter/free",                        "🌐 OpenRouter 官方動態分流")
]

OPENROUTER_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"

def auto_detect_tokens():
    gemini_keys = []
    openrouter_key = ""
    candidates = ["zen_ai_bot2.py", "zen_ai_bot1.py", "update_notioninfo_OpenRouter.py", "chart_explain.py"]
    for fname in candidates:
        fpath = os.path.join(r"C:\test_c", fname)
        if os.path.exists(fpath):
            try:
                with open(fpath, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
                    content = f.read()
                    g_matches = re.findall(r'AIza[0-9A-Za-z-_]{35}', content)
                    if g_matches: gemini_keys.extend(g_matches)
                    if not openrouter_key:
                        or_m = re.search(r'(sk-or-v1-[A-Za-z0-9a-f]+)', content)
                        if or_m: openrouter_key = or_m.group(1)
            except Exception: pass
    if not openrouter_key:
        openrouter_key = "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"
    return list(dict.fromkeys(gemini_keys)), openrouter_key

GEMINI_API_KEYS, OPENROUTER_API_KEY = auto_detect_tokens()
_working_gemini_model = None

bot = telebot.TeleBot(TG_BOT_TOKEN)

def extract_pure_code(text):
    if not text: return ""
    m = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})', str(text))
    return m.group(1) if m else ""

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    payload = {"message": message_text}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
                requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=2)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=payload, timeout=2)
    except Exception: pass

# 🗄️ 2. 全方位多源數據穿透 (大寬表 ✕ 盤中即時 ✕ 籌碼 ✕ 60M)
# =========================================================================
def fetch_complete_stock_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    result = {}
    
    # 1. 抓取全知大寬表 (View_AI_Omni_Context)
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql_omni = f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'"
            cursor.execute(sql_omni)
            cols = [c[0] for c in cursor.description]
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row:
                result.update(dict(zip(cols, row)))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 寬表查詢提醒: {e}")

    # 2. 抓取分時動能與細部籌碼 (allcross_live + Chips5 + 3Exits + Radar)
    sql_detail = """
    SELECT TOP 1
      A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, A.price_ma5, A.price_ma20, A.price_ma60,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_5MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_5MA, ISNULL(E.Return_5MA, 0.0) AS Return_5MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_10MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_10MA, ISNULL(E.Return_10MA, 0.0) AS Return_10MA,
      ISNULL(E.WinRate_20MA, 50.0) AS WinRate_20MA, ISNULL(E.Return_20MA, 0.0) AS Return_20MA,
      ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit,
      ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(C5.集中度5日, 0.0) AS 集中度5日, ISNULL(C5.集中度20日, 0.0) AS 集中度20日,
      ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.[60M_K值], 50.0) AS K_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日, 集中度5日, 集中度20日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1
    LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號)
    WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?)
    ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql_detail, (clean_code, clean_code))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r:
                result.update({
                    "m5": float(r[3] or 0), "m20": float(r[4] or 0), "m60": float(r[5] or 0),
                    "w5": float(r[6] or 50), "ret5": float(r[7] or 0),
                    "w10": float(r[8] or 50), "ret10": float(r[9] or 0),
                    "w20": float(r[10] or 50), "ret20": float(r[11] or 0),
                    "optimal": str(r[12]).strip() if r[12] else "🔥 20MA勝出",
                    "c1": float(r[13] or 0), "c5": float(r[14] or 0), "c20": float(r[15] or 0),
                    "osc_60m": float(r[16] or 0), "k_60m": float(r[17] or 50),
                    "weather": str(r[18]).strip() if r[18] else "☀️ 轉強"
                })
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ 細部特徵查詢提醒: {e}")

    return result if ("代號" in result or "名稱" in result) else None

請根據以下【唯一真實量化數據庫】，為【{data.get('名稱','')}({data.get('代號','')}】進行專業深度戰術解盤。

1. 你的所有判斷必須 100% 基於下方的 JSON 數據，嚴禁猜測、腦補未提供的新聞或數據。

# 🧠 4. 雙引擎大腦調度核心
# =========================================================================
def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS: return None, None
    candidates = GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    if _working_gemini_model:
        candidates = [c for c in candidates if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in candidates if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            print(f"👑 正在調用 Google 原廠大腦 【{model_name}】...")
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.25, "maxOutputTokens": 3500}
            }
            try:
                r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    res_json = r.json()
                    candidates_out = res_json.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        content = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 150:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 429:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 配額已滿 (429)，切換下一組金鑰...")
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 回應 {r.status_code}，切換備援...")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ 連線 {model_name} 異常: {e}，切換備援...")
                continue
    return None, None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY.strip()}",
        "HTTP-Referer": "https://zen2965.duckdns.org",
        "X-Title": "Zen AI Omni Explainer",
        "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
        "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"
    }

    last_err = ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        print(f"🌐 正在啟動 OpenRouter 雲端備援 【{model_name}】...")
        payload = {
            "model": model_id,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2500
        }
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=30)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                res_json = r.json()
                if "choices" in res_json and len(res_json["choices"]) > 0:
                    choice = res_json["choices"][0]
                    if choice.get("finish_reason") == "length": continue
                    content = choice["message"].get("content") or choice["message"].get("reasoning") or ""
                    if content and content.strip():
                        clean_content = content.strip()
                        if "<think>" in clean_content and "</think>" in clean_content:
                            clean_content = clean_content.split("</think>")[1].strip()
                        if len(clean_content) > 150:
                            actual_model = res_json.get("model", model_name)
                            return clean_content, actual_model
            else:
                last_err = f"{model_name} (HTTP {r.status_code})"
                time.sleep(0.3)
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = f"{model_name} ({e})"
            time.sleep(0.2)

    return f"❌ 所有雙引擎通道皆無回應，最後錯誤: {last_err}", "全數繁忙"

def generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode=0):
    prompt_text = build_tactical_prompt(stock_data, sub_mode)
    if GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
        if content: return content, model_name
        print("⚡ Google 原廠通道暫時滿載，0 秒無感切換至 OpenRouter 雲端集群！")
    return call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)

# 📸 5. Playwright 截圖
# =========================================================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    today = datetime.datetime.now()
    one_year_ago = (today - datetime.timedelta(days=365)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
    timestamp_now = int(time.time() * 1000)

    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}&start={one_year_ago}&_v={timestamp_now}"
    photo_filename = f"chart_{clean_code}_{timestamp_now}.png"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, photo_filename)

    print(f"🚀 Playwright 前往截圖: {url}")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        context = await browser.new_context(
            viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300},
            ignore_https_errors=True,
            extra_http_headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache"}
        )
        page = await context.new_page()
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=35000)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.5)

            current_hour_min = int(today.strftime("%H%M"))
            is_live_hours = (current_hour_min >= 900 and current_hour_min <= 1335)
            btn_target = page.locator("#btn_query_live, #btn_query_realtime") if is_live_hours else page.locator("#btn_query_post")

            if await btn_target.count() > 0 and await btn_target.is_visible():
                await btn_target.first.click()
            else:
                await page.evaluate("""
                    const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, input[type="button"], a'))
                        .find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史') || el.textContent.includes('聯動') || el.textContent.includes('即時'));
                    if (btn) btn.click();
                """)

            await asyncio.sleep(3.5)
            await page.evaluate("""
                const p = document.getElementById('html-chart-price');
                const c = document.getElementById('html-chart-cross');
                const o = document.getElementById('html-chart-obv');
                const s = document.getElementById('html-chart-score');
                if (p && o && s) {
                    const container = document.createElement('div');
                    container.id = 'clean-charts-container';
                    container.style.backgroundColor = '#0c1827';
                    container.style.padding = '10px';
                    container.style.width = '100%';
                    container.appendChild(p);
                    if (c) container.appendChild(c);
                    container.appendChild(o);
                    container.appendChild(s);
                    document.body.insertBefore(container, document.body.firstChild);
                    document.querySelectorAll('body > *').forEach(el => {
                        if (el.id !== 'clean-charts-container') el.style.display = 'none';
                    });
                }
            """)
            await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            print(f"✅ 截圖成功！")
            return output_path
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ 截圖失敗 [{clean_code}]: {e}")
            return None
        finally:
            await browser.close()

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象
    FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar
    WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0
    ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;
    """
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            return cursor.fetchall()
    except Exception: return []

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    raw_text = message.text.strip()
    chat_id = message.chat.id
    user_name = message.from_user.first_name or "使用者"

    # 全形符號自動轉半形
    raw_text = raw_text.replace('？', '?').replace('！', '!').replace('，', ',')
    print(f"\n📩 [收到用戶指令] {user_name}: 「{raw_text}」")

    # 🎯 指令 1：純問號 `?` ➔ 60M 金叉選股榜 (免打股號)
    if raw_text in ["?", "k", "K", "top", "TOP", "找金叉", "選股"]:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "⏳ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵黑馬...")
        rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
        if not rows:
            bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
        msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強黑馬榜】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
        for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
            msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]}\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
        msg += f"\n👉 手機直接打 `股號?` (例: `3443?` 或 `3443?1`) 立即查看戰報！"
        bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, msg)
        return

    # 提取純數字股票代號
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(raw_text)

    if not clean_code:
        bot.reply_to(message, "💡 純英數指令範例：\n• `3443?` ➔ 旗艦全知\n• `3443?1` ➔ 60M轉強\n• `3443?2` ➔ AMT價值區\n• `3443?3` ➔ 離場勝率\n• `3443??` ➔ 戰報＋圖表")
        return

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 2：【3443?】、【3443?1】、【3443?2】... 多維戰術分流
    # =====================================================================
    omni_match = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*(\?{1,2})\s*([0-9])?', raw_text)
    is_omni_chinese = "全知" in raw_text

    if omni_match or is_omni_chinese:
        # 判斷雙問號截圖
        is_with_photo = (omni_match and omni_match.group(2) == "??") or ("全知圖" in raw_text)
        
        # 判斷子模式 (0:全知, 1:60M, 2:AMT, 3:離場, 4:籌碼)
        sub_mode = 0
        if omni_match and omni_match.group(3):
            sub_mode = int(omni_match.group(3))

        sub_mode_names = {
            0: "👑 旗艦全知大滿貫",
            1: "⚡ 60M 伏兵轉強分時動能",
            2: "🧱 3D AMT 拍賣價值區微結構",
            3: "🛡️ 3-Way 離場勝率 ✕ 凱利風控",
            4: "💎 籌碼集中度 ✕ 法人動能"
        }
        mode_title = sub_mode_names.get(sub_mode, "👑 旗艦全知戰報")

        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在調用【{mode_title}】大腦，為【{clean_code}】生成專案戰報...")

        stock_data = fetch_complete_stock_data(clean_code)
        if not stock_data:
            bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 資料庫查無股票【{clean_code}】的資料！請確認代號是否正確。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 啟動大腦運算
        analysis, used_brain = generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode)
        now_time_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')

        clean_name = str(stock_data.get('名稱', '')).strip()

        full_report = (
            f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI {mode_title}\n"
            f"└─ 成功由大腦【{used_brain}】產出！\n\n"
            f"{analysis}\n\n"
            f"解盤時間: {now_time_str} ({used_brain})"
        )

        photo_path = None
        if is_with_photo:
            try: photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(clean_code))
            except Exception: pass

        try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        except Exception: pass

        # 發送文字
        if len(full_report) > 3800:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[:3800])
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[3800:])
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)

        send_to_line(full_report)

        # 發送截圖
        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            time.sleep(0.3)
            try:
                with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f: bot.send_photo(chat_id, f)
                send_to_line(f"📊 【{clean_code} {clean_name}】四大圖表", photo_path)
            except Exception: pass

        return

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 3：【3443p】➔ 純四大圖表截圖 (P = Photo)
    # =====================================================================
    if raw_text.lower().endswith("p") or "圖" in raw_text:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📸 正在為【{clean_code}】產出四大聯動圖表高清截圖...")
        photo_path = None
        try: photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(clean_code))
        except Exception: pass

        try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        except Exception: pass

        if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
            with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f: bot.send_photo(chat_id, f)
            send_to_line(f"📊 【{clean_code}】四大圖表", photo_path)
        else:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 【{clean_code}】截圖生成異常。")
        return

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 4：【3443r】➔ 120B 大模型深度解盤 (R = Research)
    # =====================================================================
    if raw_text.lower().endswith("r") or "說明" in raw_text:
        wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"🧠 正在啟動 120B 大模型為【{clean_code}】進行深度戰術研析...")

        analysis, used_brain = generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode=0)
        now_time_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M')
        clean_name = str(stock_data.get('名稱', '')).strip()

        full_report = (
            f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI 120B 深度研報\n"
            f"└─ 成功由大腦【{used_brain}】產出！\n\n"
            f"{analysis}\n\n"
            f"解盤時間: {now_time_str} ({used_brain})"
        )

        try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
        except Exception: pass

        bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[:3800])
        send_to_line(full_report)
        return

    # =====================================================================
    # 🎯 指令 5：預設純數字 `3443` ➔ 極速指引
    # =====================================================================
    bot.reply_to(message, (
        f"💡 標的 【{clean_code}】 極速純英數指令：\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}? ` ➔ 👑 旗艦全知戰報\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}?1 ` ➔ ⚡ 60M 伏兵轉強\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}?2 ` ➔ 🧱 3D AMT 價值區\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}?3 ` ➔ 🛡️ 3-Way 離場 ✕ 凱利風控\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}?4 ` ➔ 💎 籌碼集中度 ✕ 法人動能\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}?? ` ➔ 📸 戰報 ＋ 高清截圖大滿貫\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}p ` ➔ 📸 純圖表截圖\n"
        f"👉 ` {clean_code}r ` ➔ 🧠 120B 大模型研報"
    ))

# =========================================================================
# 🚀 7. 啟動入口
# =========================================================================
def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 雙向操盤機器人 Flagship V4.2】啟動！")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M:%S')}")

    print("⚡ 大滿貫圖文: 【3443??】或【3443??1】 / 純截圖【3443p】 / 選股【?】")
    print("🛡️ 已徹底根絕中文字切換困擾！")
    print("=" * 70)

    while True:

            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=25, long_polling_timeout=20)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 連線異常重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

-- 核心視圖結構要點：
1. 時空座標：a.日期 AS 資料日期 (保證時序精準對齊)
2. 股本基因標籤：
   - 股本 > 500 億 ➔ [巨型權值股] (需龐大法人資金推動)
   - 股本 > 50 億  ➔ [中型主力股]
   - 股本 <= 50 億 ➔ [小型輕盈飆股] (籌碼集中易爆發)
3. 動態乖離戰術判定 (解決賣飛飆股痛點)：
   - 小型飆股乖離率在 30% 內 ➔ 判定為 [小型飆股軋空主升段 (容忍高乖離)]
   - 大型權值股乖離 > 15% ➔ 判定為 [大型權值股短線過熱警告]
4. 3D AMT 價值區主力成本 (VWAP 模擬)：
   - 短線 20 日主力成本 (POC_20)
   - 波段 60 日主力成本 (POC_60)
   - 長線一年期主力成本 (POC_240)
   - 空間判定：[突破一年與一季均價，萬里無雲主升段] / [價值區間箱型震盪] / [長線空頭深水區]
5. 籌碼共振熱度：
   - 成交價金叉 + OBV金叉 + 外資金叉 + 投信金叉 (總分 32)
   - 負數 (如 -14/32) ➔ 精準指向空頭死亡交叉與法人連續賣超狀態
6. 物理去重裝甲：
   - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.代號 ORDER BY a.日期 DESC) as dedup_rn
   - 結尾 WHERE dedup_rn = 1 確保全市場每檔股票輸出絕對唯一

sql
USE [stockchangedate]
GO

IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.View_AI_Omni_Context', 'V') IS NOT NULL
    DROP VIEW [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context];
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] AS
WITH 
LatestDate AS (
    SELECT MAX(日期) as MaxDate FROM [dbo].[allcross]
),
HistData AS (
    SELECT 
        代號, 
        成交價, 
        ISNULL(總量, 0) AS Vol,
        (最高 + 最低 + 成交價) / 3.0 AS TP,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) as rn
    FROM [dbo].[amountchange]
),
AmtAgg AS (
    SELECT 
        代號,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 20 THEN TP * Vol ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 20 THEN Vol ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POC_20,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 60 THEN TP * Vol ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 60 THEN Vol ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POC_60,
        SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 240 THEN TP * Vol ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN rn <= 240 THEN Vol ELSE 0 END), 0) AS POC_240
    FROM HistData
    WHERE rn <= 240
    GROUP BY 代號
),
BaseData AS (
    SELECT 
        a.日期 AS 資料日期,
        a.代號, 
        b.名稱, 
        ISNULL(b.股本億, 10) AS 股本億,
        a.成交價, 
        a.price_ma20,
        -- 🟢 核心補齊：四維獨立金叉分項（避免 AI 抱怨缺乏分項）
        ISNULL(a.成交價黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 價格金叉分,
        ISNULL(a.obv黃金交叉次數, 0) AS OBV金叉分,
        ISNULL(a.外資黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 外資金叉分,
        ISNULL(a.投信黃金交叉次數, 0) AS 投信金叉分,
        (ISNULL(a.成交價黃金交叉次數, 0) + ISNULL(a.obv黃金交叉次數, 0) + ISNULL(a.外資黃金交叉次數, 0) + ISNULL(a.投信黃金交叉次數, 0)) AS 籌碼共振總分,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.代號 ORDER BY a.日期 DESC) as dedup_rn
    FROM [dbo].[allcross] a
    INNER JOIN [dbo].[basicinfo] b ON RTRIM(a.代號) = RTRIM(b.代號)
    WHERE a.日期 = (SELECT MaxDate FROM LatestDate)
)
SELECT 
    b.資料日期,
    b.代號,
    b.名稱,
    b.成交價,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN b.股本億 > 500 THEN '[巨型權值股]'
        WHEN b.股本億 > 50  THEN '[中型主力股]'
        ELSE '[小型輕盈飆股]'
    END AS 股本基因標籤,

    CAST(ROUND(((b.成交價 - b.price_ma20) / NULLIF(b.price_ma20, 0)) * 100, 2) AS VARCHAR) + '%' AS 月線乖離率,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN b.成交價 < b.price_ma20 THEN '[空頭弱勢，月線之下]'
        WHEN ((b.成交價 - b.price_ma20) / NULLIF(b.price_ma20, 0)) > 0.3 AND b.股本億 <= 50 THEN '[小型飆股軋空主升段 (容忍高乖離)]'
        WHEN ((b.成交價 - b.price_ma20) / NULLIF(b.price_ma20, 0)) > 0.15 AND b.股本億 > 500 THEN '[大型權值股短線過熱警告]'
        ELSE '[波段多頭健康發動區]'
    END AS 乖離戰術判定,

    CAST(ROUND(agg.POC_20, 2) AS VARCHAR) AS 短線20日主力成本,
    CAST(ROUND(agg.POC_60, 2) AS VARCHAR) AS 波段60日主力成本,
    CAST(ROUND(agg.POC_240, 2) AS VARCHAR) AS 長線一年期主力成本,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN b.成交價 > agg.POC_240 AND b.成交價 > agg.POC_60 THEN '[突破一年與一季均價，萬里無雲主升段]'
        WHEN b.成交價 > agg.POC_20 AND b.成交價 < agg.POC_60 THEN '[短線轉強，但面臨季線套牢反壓]'
        WHEN b.成交價 < agg.POC_240 THEN '[長線空頭深水區，上檔重重賣壓]'
        ELSE '[價值區間箱型震盪]'
    END AS 三維AMT空間判定,

    -- 🟢 核心補齊：四維分項明確揭露
    '價格:' + CAST(b.價格金叉分 AS VARCHAR) + 
    ' | OBV:' + CAST(b.OBV金叉分 AS VARCHAR) + 
    ' | 外資:' + CAST(b.外資金叉分 AS VARCHAR) + 
    ' | 投信:' + CAST(b.投信金叉分 AS VARCHAR) AS 四維金叉分項明細,

    CAST(b.籌碼共振總分 AS VARCHAR) + '/32' AS 籌碼共振熱度

FROM BaseData b
LEFT JOIN AmtAgg agg ON b.代號 = agg.代號
WHERE b.dedup_rn = 1;
GO
